column2: Mata
Otakada na bikogu bi Yesu Kristi ba'a wo Dauda, ba'a wo Ibrahim:
A Ibrahim go won den ashawa na Ishaku, a Ishaku wan den ashawa na Yakubu a Yakubu wan den ashawa na Yahuda natosuwa̱ nonwan,
A Yahuda wan den Ashawa na Pereza, na Zera ananwan nanwan ka Tamar go Apereza wan den ashawa na Hezron, a Hezron wan den ashawa na Ram
a Ram wan den ashawa na Aminadab, a Aminadab wan den ashawa na Nashon, a Nashon wan den ashawa na Salmon,
a Salmon wan den ashawa na Bo'aza, awo ananwan nonwan a Rahab go, a Boaz ta'a wan den ashawa na Obida, ananwan nonwan ka a Rutu go, a Obida wan den ashawa na Yesse
a Yesse ta'a wan den ashawa na Wogoma a Dauda. a Dauda wan den ashawa na Solomon, awo ananwan nonwan naanda wu'a̱ wo Uriya,
Solomon go won den ashawa na Rehobowan, a Rehobowan wan den ashawa na Biya, Abiya wan den ashawa na Asa,
Asa wan den ashawa na Yehoshapat, Ayehoshapat wan den ashawa na Yoram, Yoram wan den ashawa na Azariya,
Azariya wan den ashawa na Yotan, a Yotan wan den ashawa na Ahaz, a Ahaz wan den ashawa na Hezekiya,
a Hezekiya wan den ashawa na Manase, a Manase wan den ashawa na Amon, a Amon wan den ashawa na Yosiya,
a Yosiya go won den ashawa na Yekoniya natosuwa̱ nonwan n beka̱ni be a̱ ta̱ri ga tu ture cegema n Babila
Na a owane ga cegema n Babila a A Yekoniya wa̱ ma̱ci Sheyaltiyel, 13 Asheyaltiyal wa̱ ma̱ci Zarubabel,
Zarubabel wan den ashawa na Abihudu, a Abihudu wan den ashawa na Eliyakim, a Eliyakim wan den ashawa na Azuro,
a Azuro wan den ashawa na Saduki, a Saduki wan den ashawa na Akimu, a Akimu wan den ashawa na Aliyudu,
a Aliyudu wan den ashawa na Eli'azara, a Eli'azara wan den ashawa na Matana, a Matana go won den ashawa na Yakubu,
a Yakubu go won den ashawa na Isuhu wa̱ri wo Maryamu awu ma̱ci i Yesu, awo ata hecega a Kristi.
Ba̱nba̱nu na sorya n kushi ku Ibrahim tu hure pi Dauda kushi ko opa n ko ku na̱shi go, n to ema ga n cenge tawa ture cegema n Babila tu hure pi Kristi ta'a kushi ko opa n ko ku na̱shi go.
Anna rima̱ci ri Yesu Kristi re na na'an she a Isuhu wo tan cene'en to Maryamu she ata iyan cewo a̱ hendi wu na̱suwa̱ na sorya pa benhyan be Onhon.
Naande a Isuhu wa̱ri wo Maryamu ka woto wo omange kaye pa Onhon go, wa̱ rubi ciwu a̱ pa̱ni i Maryamu n'en nanmen nato wa̱ rubi a̱ ta̱cigi wu rihinrihin.

Ama she a Isuhu wo tan netama yan'on Wotoma wo a̱ba̱ye wo Ashawa wa rage pi Isuhu narawo wa hyen wo, “A Isuhu ba'a wo Dauda, ga'a to hoga ryansan ri tu ume i Maryamu an den wu'a̱ wo, enaande ka enan nanmen suwa̱ nonwan nasorya pa benhyan be Onhon go.
Won to mata ba'a a won to pa wo rira̱'i a Yesu enaande a̱ure won tu ringe ato nonwan nanmen ciri'i tawa.
An den ma̱no go ca na an ma shintuma̱ monran Ashawa hici nuno na Wotoma wo Onhon nhyan:
Ewana kego ke ta yan'cewo wa̱ri ken to mata ba'a, an to pa wo rira̱'i a Imanuwel, ma'anan ka “Onhon un pa̱ka̱ n ga̱tu.”
Na Isuhu wo rengane ndawo wa rope nde Wotoma wo Ashawa hyen wo, wa̱ umi Maryamu wu'a̱ wo wa.
Ama wa yan'cewo, hare wa̱ ma̱ci ba'a wo wa wa̱ pa̱ wu ta'a rira̱'i Ayesu.
Na a̱ ma̱ci i Yesu n Baitalami ona Yahudiya, a̱bire she a Hiridus wogoma won togoma, a̱huwa̱ na sorya arowa a rage n Urshalima
ta'a a̱ rushigi a hyen, “Nca wogoma wo Yahudawa awo a̱ ma̱ci? enande to hyande benangare arowa go ato rage to pana wo ototo.
Na wogoma a Hiridus wo hoge a̱nno, anmen nonwan a̱ kurki, a̱nde ta'a ca nato na Urshalima.
Wogoma a Hiridus wa romano ato ca na ato ototo na Firistoci n shima̱la̱n she tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa, wa̱ rushigi ga wa hyen, nca pa a̱ ma̱ci Ikristi.
A hyen wo, “N ceso na Baitalami ona Yahudiya go, nde Wotoma wo Onhon wo range to hyan:
“Gawo Baitalami, n cenge to Yahudiya, gawo nce ba'a go nanmen nan awon nan togoma to Yahudiya. Enande nanmen gawo an to mata yan'on wogoma awon ton dan wuhuwa̱ wo ato na̱mi Israila.”
a Hiridus wa hecegane ato na yan'son nnangare rihinrihin na wan ma yan'son n beka̱ni be a̱ hendi benangare bire.
Wa tomane ga tu hura̱n Baitalami wa hyen, “Hura̱ ba ken kerkakya kya'o kire san. She i wuri wu, ke mokosha kin bishi, ga̱mi ta'a n hura̱ n pana wo ototo.”
Na a̱ hu to hoga monran ma wogoma a Hiridus, a kentane tohano tawa. Benangare be a̱ hendi ka arowa bya owangane ga onyan hare a̱ ci pa kya'o kire ke ne'en.
Na a̱ hendi benangare bire a̱ shini na anmen cende cenmon.
Na a̱ gegi n egewa wa̱re a̱ wuri kya'o kire na ananwan nonwan Amaryamu, a̱ kuki, a̱ pa̱ni wu ototo. A̱bire a̱ ka̱rigi aronga nanwan a̱ pa̱ni wu ezenare, n mananbe ma rotome usunsun, n Mur.
Ama abe an mokosa a rope onyan na̱ba̱ tu hura̱ n cenge tawa, enaande Onhon u hundika̱no ga atobe narawo nhyen a̱re a mokosakan cewo pi Hiridus.

Na ato na yan'son nnangare a̱ huri yan'on Wotoma wo a̱ba̱ye wo Ashawa wa rage pi A Isuhu narawo wa hyen i Isuhu, “I kurika̱,” ku umi kya'o kenna na nanwan ki ga̱ri tu hura̱ n cenge to Masar. Ke na'an pa̱re hare sheshe n be hyen ke mokosha, enaande wogoma a Hiridus won ta sara behono be kya'o kenna a kone wo.
a Isuhu wa̱ kurki, wa̱ umi kya'o kire na nanwan n geta wa̱ hurin cenge to Masar,
wa koreke pa̱re hare a Hiridus wa̱ u. An den ma̱no go na an ma shintuma̱na̱ monran ma Ashawa a̱ hici nuno na Wotoma wo Onhon ama hyan, “Nasorya n Masar an hecegane Ba'a wu mi.”

Na a Hiridus wu ma̱pi n hyen ato na yan'son nnangare a getoge wo topano, anmen a̱ ba̱'i wu cenmon wa tomane a konage kobe ba'a wa̱ri awon nanmen Baitalami n peringo na owa, nari a'o nan n'yan dewu tu huren kida̱ na̱riye n beka̱ni be wa hoge monran ma̱re pa ato na yan'son nnangare.
A̱bire be a̱ shintuma̱na̱ tu hita̱ to Wotoma wo Onhon a Irmiya ama hyan.
“A hoge yan'on bengoro be to'ogwa n Rama nanmen shiri ana ba̱'i, Arahila go won nan ngwan nan a'o nonwan, wa rawon to hogakana akaremana, enaande a rakau.”
Ama na a Hiridus wu u nanden a̱ hendi Wotoma wo a̱ba̱ye Ashawa wa soran Isuhu narawo n Masar wa hyen wo.
I kurika̱ ku umi ba'a wonna na ananwan ki hurin n be'awo be cenge to Israila, enande ato nan saro behono be wa a o'gi.
a Isuhu wa̱ kurki wa̱ umi ba'a na nanwan a ragen n be'awo be cenge to Israila.

Na a Isuhu wo hoge nhyen a Arkilawus wu na̱da̱ni ka̱shiki ka ashawa nonwan a Hiridus wan togoma to Yahudiya, wa hoge ryansan ri tuta̱ pa̱re, ama na a woshe wo ogago narawo nanden wa̱ ma̱ga̱shi tu hura̱n cenge to Galili.
Naande wa̱ huri wa koreke n yan'on oceso ona ata hyan Nazarat, na an ma shintuma̱na̱ tu hita̱ to Wotoma wo Onhon tohyan, an to hecegana Iyesu woto wo Nazarat.
Nan n'yan mande gu Ayohana wo Baptisma wo rage, wan tobansan n shihira̱ she Yahudiya.
Wa ange, ma̱shishingi ba, beka̱ni be Onhon on ton da togoma to tonran be ne'enyan keto.
A̱ure wo Wotoma a Ishaya won monran ma wa tohyan, “Bengoro ben hece n cenge tu ho'i, bya ange, enangana ba ashawa onyan, ki ka̱binga̱gi enyanyan nonwan.”
Ayohana ka wa̱ ma̱ta̱'a̱ni ewa na tunjira̱ to ura̱kumi, wa̱ ma̱ pa̱ra̱gi adamanran na̱nbi nonwan, irikorya nonwan ka shawaga shego n tuso'in
Nande ato na Urshalima, nato na Yahudiya ca nato na cenge tu usuna̱ na ube na Urdun, an to ragage pi Yohana,
Wan to dangaga obaptisma n ube na Urdun, an tu hita̱ga̱ ciri'i tawa.
Na Yohana wu hendi Aparisiyawa na Sadukiyawa cenmon, a rage a dange ga o Baptisma, wa hyen ga, ga̱hin a korowa! A̱ure waye woshe ogago, ki ga̱nra̱ni ma̱gina̱ ma ne'enyan dewo?
En dan ba otoma nan tu bisa̱ to hyen e ma̱shishinga̱, n mangasa ma̱hin.
Ga'a ba to rwana nanmen na̱hin nhyen, a Ibrahim gu won den ashawa na̱hin, n ne'en bi bisa̱ga̱, Onhon omange a̱ta̱ra̱n a dange Ibrahim a'o na tare wanna.
Uno na unga̱ta̱ri o no'an na̱bi na o'o, ca o'o na pa̱n ciwu ri'ori re reme an tu kire ogo a mashe nanmen nora.

“Ga̱mi n ma̱ni gu nan be danganga o Baptisma, na an ma bisa̱ ma̱shishinga̱ ma̱hin, ama woto awo ne'enyan dewo na bo'o na̱mi wun huri uru, ko ataka nonwan n doga cewo n atana. A̱ure won be dangya o Baptisma in benhyan be Onhon pa̱ka̱ nora.
Obara na to pesaga ken ka'ara kauwa, won to woshega pa̱ri pa to sauraga, a romano o alkama nonwan a rogane n kapanga, ama a̱kuku, won to dortoma ago n nora naca o'ga̱.
A Yesu ta'a nasoryan cenge to Galili wa ragen n ube na Urdun Ayohana an den wo obaptisma.
Ama Ayohana wa̱ rubin to gamanga wo, wa hyen Iyesu, ga̱mi woto wo nan saro kon men dange obaptisma, awo rage pimi?”
Ama Ayesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱n bu wa hyen, “Ga'a ma na'an anna benanba, enande anna ma reme tu shintuma̱na̱ okaye.” nande Ayohana wa̱ pa̱ni unbu wa dange Iyesu obaptisma.
Na an dange Iyesu obaptisma, a̱bire n ba sorya n ma̱ni, nande tonran to ma̱'ucigi wa hendi benhyan be Onhon ben tugurga̱ni she ka̱rkutu, ka̱ ka̱ra̱ni n unbu nonwan.
Naande a hoge yan'on bengoro pa̱re n tonran be hyan, awonna Ba'a wu mi go awon Rubi, awon ne'en nanmen cende nonwan.
Nande benhyan be Onhon bya owane Yesu n cenge tu ho'i, kitunbul ki ma̱'in wu.
Na wan den a̱hibi opa na̱shi nageta opa na̱shi, n re'ore wa hoge renmonron.
Nande woto wo tomo'on wa rage pewa wa hyen, “She gawo Ba'a wo Onhon go, hyen otare wanna o magiwuro irikorya.”
Ayesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni wa hyen, “A range nhyen: nce niri korya bawa go woto won to na'an nehono, ama n monran ma sorya pa Onhon.”
Kitunbul ta'a kya uwanakane Iyesu n bikira̱n be egewa na Onhon n Urshalima pa ce'en.
“Kya hyen wo, she gawo Ba'a wo Onhon go,” matacege unbu nanwon n kida̱. Enande a range nhyen: “Won to hyen atoma na a̱ba̱ye nonwan awo sa̱ka̱ni, wo rawon to kenya ko kolage.”
Ayesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱n bu wa hyen, a range nhyen: Kure ma̱'a̱ni Ashawa Onhon nanwon.”
Kitunbul kya uwanakane Iyesu nudu rowa ke bisa̱gi wu ca togoma to kanniyan n uru na towa.
“Kitunbul kya hyen wo, nan bo pana iriri wanna ca she wu kuki awon men dange sojada.”
Ayesu wa hyen wo “N pa̱gi pa̱ri, gawo kitunbul! a range n hyen Ashawa Onhon nanwon go won to dangya cegema n to hewaka obawa.”
A̱bire kitunbul ke ga̱'i Yesu, atoma na a̱ba̱ye a rage a̱ beni wu.
Na Ayesu wo hoge nhyen a owane I yohana n kurkuku, wa mokoshen Galili.
Wa̱ ga̱'i o Nazarat, wa̱ huri wa koreke n Kaparnahun n suna̱ na ube na uru, n ita̱nu na cenge to Zabaluna n Naptali,
na an ma shintuma̱na̱ monran ma Wotoma wo Onhon a Ishaya ama hyan:
“Cenge to Zabaluna n cenge to Naptali, n be'awo be Baha, n kaca na Ube na Urdun, n Galili n be'awo be ato naande cewo a Yahudawa,
Ato na yan'cewo Onhon A̱ hendi tohan'an to Onhon, ato na koreke keto nu'o, Tohan'an twa ragane ga.”
Nasorya n beka̱ni bire Ayesu wa̱ ri tobansan, wa ange “ma̱shishingi ba, beka̱ni be Onhon ton dan togoma to tonran to ato nonwan o ne'enyan keto.”

a Yesu won tohano n be'awo be Ube na Galili go a̱nno wa̱ wuri yan'on ato suwa̱ rewu, a Saminu awo ata hecega i Bitrus n woto suwa̱ wo wa Andarawus. She an to masanga ika̱li nanwan nube na uru enaande awa ato na to kentaga nwa̱ gu.
A Yesu wa hyen ga, n dope ba nan be giwuro ato na tokentagana ato to rage pimi.”
a̱birebire a̱ ga̱'i ika̱li nanwan a rope i Yesu.

Na a maheketane, wa̱ wura̱ka̱ni ato rewu, awa ta'a ato suwa̱ go, Ayakubu ba'a wo Zabadi, n woto suwa̱ wo wa Ayohana, nanmen ohato pa̱ka̱ na ashawa nanwan Azabadi she an to nangana ika̱li nanwan. Ayesu wa hecegane ga.
A̱birebire a̱ ga̱'i ohato nanwan nashawa nanwan a rope Iyesu.
a Yesu wa̱ peringa̱na̱ Ogalili, wan tubisa̱ga̱ ga n sheworo she aduwa, wan tobansan monran ma rotome ma togoma to Onhon, ta'a wan to hogaka kobe shegoma she ato.
Monran ma Yesu ma̱ gegi ba̱nba̱n cenge to Suriya, ato a uwangane ato na rumanga̱gi ba̱nta̱ba̱nta̱, nato nan ma̱supo nato na omange npera, nato na ma̱'uwa̱'uwa̱, nato na ma'inna a Yesu wa hogake ga.
Ato na yemi cenmon a rope wo nasoryan Galili, nan awon nan cesonceson opa n Urshalima, n Yahudiya, ta'a n kaca na ube na Urdun.
Na Yesu wu hendi ato a maromano cenmon, naande wa̱ na̱da̱ni undu. Na wa koreke, ato na moma'anga nonwan a rage pewa
Naande wa̱ bisa̱gi ga wa hyen,
Uno na reme on pa ato na yan'son okeno nanwan ona benhyan, naande togoma to tonran tawa togo
Uno na reme on pa ato nan netama, naande an tu horpa̱ka̱ ga shenmen
Uno na reme on pa ato na rawon, tosheka, nande an to paka kanniyan
Uno na reme on pa ato nan ha̱nda̱ n kaye, nande an to topagya ga ena a̱ rubi.
Uno na reme on pa ato na to hoga yanman, nande awa ta'a an to hoga yanman nanwan.
Uno na reme on pa ato na shenmen she reme nande an to hyanda Onhon.
Uno na reme on pa ato nata upa̱ ma̱ka̱ enande an to hyen ga a'o na Onhon
Uno na reme on pa ato nan huwa̱gina̱ n ton danga ena reme, enande togoma to tonran tawa togo.
“Uno na reme un pihin sha ato aye twa'age aye pinrin aye ta̱gi kobe iri na kenoko
En dan ba anmen cende ke hoge rato naande ocewa na̱hin ona uru go n tonran, a̱nde a̱ pinrin Atoma na Onhon na yi ciga̱no
“Ga̱hin she ma̱hota̱ go e ne'en n kanniyan, she ma̱hota̱ ma u niwa̱ gu an to naganaka mago, ma rakau yan'on olema an to tura̱ mago go ato ta'a a pondage
“Ga̱hin go tohan'an to kanniyan, oceso nan kogo owa ca ma̱so'a̱n
A ca ta'a ta becella a masane n kuwongu, ama a tatanen bego n be'oro go apa ben to han'anka ba̱nba̱n ato nan negewa.
Tohan'an tuhin to na'an han'anka a̱nde pa ato, naande a̱ hendi otoma na̱hin ona reme, a hewake Ashawa na̱hin anan nanmen tonran.
“Ga'a ba to anga n dage n ciringa̱ tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa n tubisa̱ga̱ to atoma na Onhon go, ama n dage go n shintuma̱nga̱.
mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱ga̱, tonran n kinda̱ ton ta nanga, ama ko ika̱ n tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa rawon to nanga, she sha a shintuma̱ ko'iwo

Nadea̱nno, woto wu ta̱'i monran ko ma̱ka̱ ma yemi ciwu an to hyen wo woto wu yemi ciwu n togoma to tonran, ta'a woto wo rope mago ka, hare wa̱ hici mago an to hyan won woto wu yemi n togoma to tonran.
Nan bi bisa̱ga̱, sha otoma na̱hin n kaye u huri ciwu ona shima̱la̱n she tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa na Farisiyawa, e rawon tu gega̱ n togoma to tonran.
“E hoge na a̱ bishi atoma naye ciga̱no nhyen, a̱ ga̱'i to kona woto, woto kone woto wuba̱, karere kan to kentana wo.

Ga̱mi ta'a n ne'en bi bisa̱ga̱, woto wu ma̱gini n woyan'on wo wa, karere kan to kentana wo, ko'eyawa ta'a awo hyen woto wuba̱ topano, Onhon to mansana wo n egewa na ora, ko'eyawa wo hyen gawo opera a̱nde ta'a wun tu gega̱ negewa na ora
“Nadea̱nno, sha won to pana osadaka n bekondo be Onhon, a̱bire ta'a awu ma̱ta̱ma̱ringi nhyen wo omange yan'on monran n woyan'on wo
Ko esake o sadaka nanwon n egora na iwuki na Onhon, nande ku huri ke maropano n woyan'on wo nande ko rage ko cewane osadaka nanwon

“Ko den kushine ko maropan n woto wo owane pa woto wo shetara she etan tohano pa shetara, ma̱re woto wure awo ta̱ga̱nu n woto shetara, woto wo shetara ta'a awo owane pa a iya na wogoma, awo mansan n kurkuku.
Mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱ga̱, wo rawon to sora pa̱re, she sha wo tope ba̱nba̱n, ukobo rawo nan tu cena̱.
“E hoge a hyan, ga̱'a ton dan ma̱ye'o.
Ama ko'eyawa awo gotage wu'a̱ togotaga to turuwa̱ n anmen won dwa ma̱ye'o gu a̱nde n rekoko rewa.
She rishe rewo re katoga re ta wo kuna̱ ton dan ciri'i, to koika rego ko mashe, in bu hura̱ ku ra̱shi be'awo binba̱ be to'oawa towo na an ma mansan to'oawa towo ka̱buri n egewa na ora.
She ta'a ka'ara kawo ka katoga ka ta wo kuna̱ ton dan ciri'i, to kera kago ko mashe. in bu hura̱ ku ra̱shi be'awo binba̱ be to'oawa towo na an ma mansana togo ba̱nba̱n n egewa na ora.
“Onhon ta'a o hyan n monran mowwa nhyen woto wo ta̱cigi wu'a̱ wowa a̱ pa̱ni wu otakada na tacegwa.’
Ama ga̱mi n bi bishi nhyen woto wu ta̱cigi wu'a̱ wo wa shen ce nhyen wo kentan bo n ma̱ye'o gu, to wu kuwa̱n bu ma̱ye'o gu a̱nde woto wu ha̱ni wu ta'a wu kuwa̱n bu ma̱ye'o.
“Ta'a e hogwa a hyen ato na huro, ga'a ba ma̱shiwuro, ama ga̱mi n hyen shi'a̱ nshiwuron na me won den na Ashawa.
Ama n bi bishi, ga'a ba mashiwuro: Ko n tonran, naande pa̱ri pa ane'en na Onhon go.
ko ta'a n cenge, naande apa toponda tuwa pago, ko ta'a n Urshalima, naande oceso na uru na wogoma go.
Ta'a ga'a ba ma̱shiwuron n unbu na̱hin, naande e rawon to yan'son tu shishinga̱ ko ka̱njinra̱ ka̱ka̱ ka na'an ka shiri ko ka na'an ka cende.
‘En’ na̱hin on den ‘En’‘A'a’ na̱hin ta'a o na'an ‘A'a’, ena huri a̱nno e sorya pa woto wo kenoko go.
“E hoge a hyan, rishe rehawo ri rishe, rine rehawo ri rine.’
Ama n bi bishi, ga'a ba to esa aye dangage. She woto wo kenoko wo komane tamashe n regawo re katoga getogagya wo re ka̱ngura̱.
she ta'a woto wuba̱ wo owane apa shetara nhyen awu ra̱'i ewa nanwon, ga'agya wo ena ma̱'uta̱na̱ ma wo.
She woto wuba̱ wu kuwa̱ni ken den tohano to tu'uniga̱ to woto tuka̱, ken den tohano to tu uniga̱ woto ma̱rewu.
Pana woto wu rushigi, woto sa̱ri to'opa pewo kure ko gamangan cewo.
“E hoge a hyan, ‘Ruwa̱ ba ca ayan'on na̱hin ke eshe ato nayi rubi ciwu.’
Ama ga̱mi n bi bishi nhyen: Ruwa̱ ba ato nayi rubi ciwu ko dange ato na wo pinrin aduwa,
Na en ma dan a'o na Ashawa na̱hin anan tonran awo ton dan onhun o sorya n unbu na ato na kenoko nato na reme, a tomane na shira̱ pa ato na omange kaye nato na rawo kaye.
She ato naye rubi abawa go i rubi ocewa na̱be go i cigi? nce a̱nde go ato na kenoko n ato na tora'aga ka̱gondo an nenwan?
she ta'a ayan'on na̱hin go eta kuwa̱ abawa, yegu eta dan na huri na ato na̱ba̱? nce a̱nde ato na yan'cewo Onhon ata dan?
Ke na'an kamon, she nde Ashawa na̱hin anan tonran a ne'en.
“En da ba suku, ma̱re ton da kaye na̱hin ton de tohyanda to a̱she, she en den a̱nde e rawon tu ciga̱ ocewa na̱hin pa Ashawa n tonran.
“She i pa̱ni ato na rawo osadaka ga'a ba to na'an tu hita̱ga̱ she nde ato na tuka̱ryo ata dan n pa̱ri pa aduwa nanwan nonyan ta'a na ato an ma hewaka ga, mahenda a̱ ra̱'o ocewa nanwan go a̱nde
ama ga̱hin she en ton da osadaka ka'ara ka̱hin ka̱ ka̱ngura̱ ka̱re ka yan'cewo ena ka'ara ka katoga kan nenwan.
Na osadaka nanwon ma na'an rinhinrinhin, Ashawa nanwon ka na hendi ca ena won nenwan rinhinrinhin won bo pana ocewa.

“Ta'a she en ton dan aduwa kire ke rawon nenwan nshe ato na tuka̱ryo, ana ta ruwa̱ to na'an na aduwa be'eshe n pa̱ri pa aduwa nen yan'yan ta'a na ato an ma hyanda ga. Mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱, a̱ ra̱'o ocewa nanwan.
Ama she won ton dan aduwa, ku gegi n ka̱woro ka anmen kawo, ku uta̱ni bewangano ko den aduwa pa Ashawa nanwon, awo a ca hyanda, Ashawa nanwon ka ana ta hyanda rinhinrinhin won bo pana ocewa nanwon.
She ta'a en na aduwa kire ke rawon ni hita̱gihita̱gi na yemi nshe ato na yan'cewo Onhon, ana ta na'an netama nhyen she an den ihita̱gihita̱gi na yemi go an to hoga ga.
Ki ga̱'i ton dan she awa, naande ashawa na̱hin a yan'swan nhyen en saro she eta rushigi ciwu.
“Anna en ton dan aduwa: “‘Ashawa na̱tu anan dewa nanmen tonran, a̱ pa̱ni rira̱'i rewo ototo.
Togoma towo to rage, ena wu rubi an den n kanniyan she nde eya ne'en n tonran.
Ku tu pa̱ni iri korya na yara nena bekene.
Ku tu ciringa̱gi ciri'i tutu, nde tota ciringa̱ge ato na ton dangage.
kure ko to owan cewo pa tomo'on, ama ku tu a̱pa̱ni n woto wo kenoko.’
Nande she i ciringa̱gi ato naye dangage, Ashawa na̱hin ta'a anan nanmen tonran an bi ciringa̱ge ta'a.
Ama she i ciringa̱gi ciwu ato naye dangage, Ashawa na̱hin ta'a anan tonran a rawon be recengagya ciri'i tuhin.

“She en re'ore, kire ki ha̱ciga̱ni ciwu a̱she nde ato na tuka̱ryo ata dan, naande ata hacegana a̱she na ko'eyawa wan ma hyanda nhyen an re'ore. Mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱ga̱ a̱ ra̱'o ocewa nanwan wono.
Ama ga̱hin she en re'ore, ku ma̱shigici a̱she nanwon ku ma̱hopa̱ni mananbe n unbu,
ma̱re ato ma̱pi nhyen en re'ore, ba̱nta̱ Nashawa nanwon abawa ana a ca hyanda, Ashawa nanwon ta'a awo gotage ca ena en nenwan rinhinrinhin won be pana ocewa
“Kire ke romangage cewo unbu na̱hin toryan'on n kanniyan, apa renhyan n tuwo ton to hacegana, apa a̱nhin ta'a an to yan'son to koma a̱ gegi a̱ hin.
Ama ke maromangya unbu na̱hin toryan'on n tonran, apa renhyan n tuwo rawon to hacegana, ta'a a̱nhin a rawon to yan'son tu hen.
Nade apa toryan'on towo to ne'en a̱pa̱re pa anmen nanwon ata na'an.
“A̱she a̱wa̱re an den becella be to'oawa. She a̱she nanwon an kamon ca to'oawa towo tun tu shina̱ n tohan'an
Ama she a̱she nanwon a rawo kamon, ca to'oawa towo to rawo to omanga toha'an, she tohan'an to to'oawa towo ton den cici, mahenda cici ture tun ta̱ yema̱!

“Woto wo rawo awon ton dan wogema nande a na'an toma pa ato na egewa rewu, ko a̱ rubi wuka̱ a eshe wuka̱, ko ta'a won to na'an ropa monran ma woto wuka̱ a̱re a rope cewo ma woto won hyan'on. Ma rawon man dan ke na'an ropa Ashawa Onhon naande ta'a ke na'an ropa nsara.

“Nadea̱nno nen bi bisa̱ga̱ nhyen, kire ki ma̱ta̱ ciwu etama na ena en korya, ko ena en to swa, ko ta'a na en tu ciga̱ mewa na en mata'agana n to'oawa tuhin, behono bi huri ciwu irikorya, ta'a to'oawa tu huri ciwu aronga?
Ruka̱ ba n'na̱na̱na̱ nan tonran, myaca bera ta'a myaca guwa̱ myaca ta'a roga n kapanga, ca nande Ashawa na̱hin anan tonran ata ryaka ngo, i huri ciwu gwa?
A̱ure nanmen ga̱hin awon to yan'son a̱ ka̱sa̱ni unbu nonwan ageta sa̱bo na etama nonwan?
Ta'a na go i ma̱ta̱ etama sa̱bo na mewa na mata'ana? Ruka̱ ba na tusuma̱ tu ka̱wo na twa ta na'an uru. myaca na'an toma ko ta'a rene'en.
Ca nande nen bi bisa̱ga̱ ko Wogoma a Solomon ca n ototo nonwan wo ta den cewo makyaranga ma̱ci ma tusuma̱ ture.

To hare she Onhon on to yan'son to kyanranga anben na̱ ka̱wo anna, ana ta na'an yara bi'i a masane togo nanmen n kuwa̱ngu ko ora a dortoma, balle ga̱hin? A̱ ga̱hin ato na rawo tomasana anmen tu yemi ciwu!
Nadea̱nno ki ga̱'i mata etama nhyen, ‘Yegu ton korya.’ ko ta'a ‘Yegu ton to swa’ ko ta'a, “Yegu ton mata'ana?’
Nande ato na yan'cewo Onhon go ata na'an saro na iriri wono, Ashawa na̱hin ka anan tonran a yan'swan nhyen en saro iriri wono.
Ena den na reme ena ka̱hin iwa̱re, ke cewane unbu na̱hin niriri na togoma to Onhon ke na'an danga ena omange kaye, an be pana hare niriri wono.
Nadea̱nno ki ga̱'i mata etama sa̱bo na bi'i, naande bi'i omange ma̱supo ma mawa. Kobe uhibi omange ma̱supo ma owa.
“Ga'a ba to keragya ko'eyawa karere ma̱re ga̱hin ta'a aye kerage,
nde e kerage woto wunba̱ karere a̱nde an be keregya nde i ma̱'a̱ngi woto wuba̱ a̱nde an be ma'angya.
Nago won tu ruka̱ka̱ owanbe kin rishe re woto wuba̱ awo ga̱'i utubi nan rishe rewo?
Nago won to hyen woyan'on wo, an bo recengagya owanbe n rishe rewo, ewana ka gawo utubi go un rishe rewo?
Gawo wuka̱ryo, riye to recenga utubi nan rishe rewo, naande bire ku hendi pa̱ri oderai na won to recenga owanbe nan rishe re woyan'on wo.
“Ga'a ba to pana shaa ena shigere ciwu. ga'a ba ta'a to masangya arere na egewa ulu'ulu'u na̱hin. ma̱re a pondange a magetogya aye ha̱nda̱ganu.
“Rushiga̱ ba an be pana, sara ba en tu ciga̱, emanga ba a̱no an be uciga̱ge.
Naande woto wu rushigi ata pana wo, awo sa̱ri ta'a wuta̱ ciga̱, ta'a woto wo emani ta'a ata uciga̱ge wo a̱no.
“A̱ure, she ba'a wo wu rushigi wu apoen a̱ pa̱ni wu otare?
ko ta'a she wu rushigi wu biwa̱, a pa̱ni wu ohwa'a?
She ga̱hin, ato na omange etama na kenoko e yan'son na en to pana a'o na̱hin ena reme, naande Ashawa na̱hin anan tonran anan to pana iri na reme pa ato na sa̱ri pewa?
Nadea̱nno ena en saro ato aye dange, ga̱hin ta'a ke dange ga, enande ewanna go den attaura n tubisa̱ga̱ to atoma.
Gega̱ ba na̱no na suki, enande a̱no na hurin u'o ona ha̱nrin gu, on'yan na owa ta'a ona gome cewo tu huma̱ go, ato na tu huma̱ ogo a̱ yemi.
Nadea̱nno na behono ka ona suki go, ato na tu ciga̱ ogo ryawo go.
“Owana ba suku na atoma na tobya. anan to rage nan mewa na me a̱ta̱ka̱ na ita̱ma̱'in, ama nanmen nanwan a kerkece go.
En to mapa ga n toma nanwan. An to yan'son to ceba oalkama nanmen na a̱sa̱pi ko ta'a riori re uka̱ma̱ma̱ nika̱rika̱ri?
A̱nde ta'a kobe o'o na reme ota pana ri'ori re reme. O'o na reme cewo ta'a ota pana ri'ori re reme cewo.
O'o na reme o rawon to yan'son to pana ri'ori reme cewo. A̱nde ta'a o'o na reme cewo o rawon to yan'son to pana ri'ori re reme.
Ca o'o na pa̱ni ciwu ri'ori re reme an tu kire ogo a mashen nora.
Nadea̱nno n toma nanwan go an to mapa ga.
“Nca ko'eyawa awo tan hyan Ashawa, Ashawa, go won tu gega̱ n togoma to tonran, sede woto won den iri na Ashawa nan tonran an saro.
Ato cenmon an to hyan n hibi wa̱re, Ashawa, Ashawa, ashe ton den cewo anabci n rira̱'i rewo, n rira̱'i rewo ta'a to sortomange cewo npera a ton den iriri na yema̱gi?
A̱bire nan tu bisa̱ ga nhyen nbe yan'cewo. Npa̱gi ba, ga̱hin ato na kenoko
“Nadea̱nno woto hoge monran ma̱mi wa̱ shi'i mago n rekoko rewa wo ne'en she woto wu ma̱ egewa nonwan nisupa̱ go.
Na̱ a̱shira̱ a kenya, opera uwa̱ kurke uwa̱ hupurgi egewa ca nande eya ken cewo, enaande a̱ shi'i egewa wa̱re nisupa̱.
Ama woto wo hoge monran ma̱mi wa̱ shi'i ciwu mago nanmen nonwan wo ne'en she topano tu ma̱ egewa nonwan n haro go.
Na̱ a̱shira̱ kenyan myanron me shini, ta'a opera uwa̱ hupirge uwa̱ ripi egewa wa̱re, eya kenange.”
Na Yesu hu tu hita̱ ma̱no, ato an den mamake n tubisa̱ga̱ ture,
Enaande wu bishi ga monran she woto awo omange a̱ta̱ra̱n, nshe ta'a shima̱la̱n she tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa.
Na Yesu ka̱ra̱ni nudu ato cenmon a rope wo
yan'on woton koci wa rage pi Yesu wa̱ kuki bu wa hyen wo, “Ashawa she wun ra̱'a̱ni kon hogake.”
Ayesu wa cewane ka'ara kauwa wa̱ a̱ta̱ni woton koci wure wa hyen “N ra̱'a̱ni,” “Maremake.”A̱birebire wa mahoge
Nande Ayesu wa hyen wo, “Benreka kure ku bishi ciwu ko'eyawa” Ama hura̱ ku bishi unbu nanwon pa Firist ku pa̱ni iwuki nde tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa to hyen. En da a̱nno na an ma bisa̱ ato nhyen wo mahoge.”
Na Yesu wu gegin Kaparnahun yan'on woto ototo wo ato na ma̱ka̱ri wo Roma wa rage pi Yesu wa̱ kuki wa̱ sa̱ri wa hyen wo.
“Ashawa” Wogema wu mi wun pa̱re wu wa̱ci n egewa wu ruma̱gi ma'inna”
A Yesu wa hyen wo, “N ne'enyan dewo n hogaka wo.”
Nande woto ototo wo ato na ma̱ka̱ri wure wo Roma wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni wa hyen Iyesu, “Ashawa, N doga cewo ko rage negewa na̱mi. Ama en dan monran wogema wumi won mohoga.
Ga̱mi n unbu na̱mi n ka'ara ka woto go n ne'en ta'a wogema n ka'ara ka̱mi. she n hyen woto na ‘Hura̱,’ a̱ huri, she n hyen wo ta'a, ‘Rage,’a rage ta'a.”
Na Yesu wo hoge a̱nde naande wan de omamake, wa hyen ato nan toropa wo “Mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱ga̱ ko nanmen Israila n ta̱ cigi ciwu woto wo tomasana anmen to otope she to woto wonna.
N ne'en bi bisa̱ga̱, ato cenmon to rage arowa na kida̱ korya iri korya na Ibrahim na Ishaku na Yakubu n togoma to tonran
Ato na togoma a mashegan pa̱ri pa ici. pa̱re pa an to twan ngwa n marya a̱ne
nande Ayesu wa hyen woto ototo wo ato na ma̱ka̱ri ana ogesa ryaga en bon dan n to masana anmen towo.” a̱ bire wogema wo wa, wa mohoge.
Na Ayesu wo gegi n egewa na Bitrus wa̱ buri aniya na Bitrus wu wa̱ci n turu wa ange to'oawa.
Wa̱ a̱ta̱ni ka'ara kauwa wa mohoge wa̱ kuriki wan dange wo ena korya
Na marona man den a owongane ato na omange npera cenmon wa sortomanga npera monran wa hogake ato na ruma̱ga̱gi
A̱ma̱re ka na an ma shintuma̱na̱ monran ma Wotoma Ishaya wu hici go tohyan: “N unbu nonwan go wa recenge ohoge cewo rato na̱tu wa umi egome gome na̱tu.”
Na Ayesu wu hendi ato cenmon a peringa̱na̱ wo wa hyen ga a̱ ka̱ci hira̱ re nube
Nande yan'on “Ka̱ma̱la̱n ka tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa ka rage ka hyen wo, “Ka̱ma̱la̱n, nan bo ropa apa wun tu hura̱
Ayesu wa hyen ga, shejewo un shira̱mu she shewa. Kina̱na̱ ke tonran ta'a en tugurgu to shewa. Ama ga̱mi Ba'a wo woto n dawo pa̱ri pa nan to masana unbu na̱mi
Yan'on woto wo moma'anga wa hyen wo, “Ashawa ga'a naande n hura̱ n mi ma̱ni ashawa na̱mi ana u.”
Ayesu ta'a wa hyen wo, “N dope, ga'a ato na eshe man dopa ana rawo benhyan a̱ ma̱ni ayan'on nanwon na o'gi.
Na Yesu wo gegi ohato ato na moma'anga nonwan a rope wo.
She ata geshen cewo yan'on uriro na yemi uwa̱ kurke nube arasana na ma̱ni ma̱ ri tu gega̱ nanmen ohato ama Ayesu wan nan dawo
Ato na moma'anga nonwan a̱ huri a retamaga wo a hyen, “Ashawa tu ringe tun tu uwa̱”
Wa hyen ga, “nago en ryansan?” Ga̱hin ato na tomasana anmen tu yemi ciwu?” nande wa kuriki wa̱ gusa̱ni opera n nube opera uwa̱ wa̱ci
Ato an ualajibi, a̱ rushigi a hyen, “Wobi iri na woto go wanna? awo opera n ma̱ni ma ube mata hoga wo ta'a?”
N ba ka̱ci be'awo be cenge to Garasinawa ato rewu na omange npera a sorya apa ata bisa̱ ato, a̱ wuri wu, an neperen na̱ci pa woto rawo awon to yan'son tu huma̱ onyan wa̱re.
“Yegu won sara n ga̱tu, wo rage ko to ce'entoma gwa? pana she beka̱ni bi tu beta den cewo
Pa̱re ryawo ka yan'on ukutu na arere na egewa an dewa n rihuwo
Nande npera mya roki wu nhyan, she wo to sortoma ko to masan nanmen ukutu na arere na egewa re
Wa hyen ga ryaga ba, nande a sore a gegi na arere na egewa, naande banban narere a̱ ma̱'ici a kyenan nube a̱ u n ma̱ni.
A̱huwa̱ na arere na egewa ama ici tu hura̱ n ceso nanmen an tu hita̱ga̱ ena a̱ hendi, n niri na̱ cigi ato na omange nperan nan uru.
Nande ca ato nan ceso a sorage a̱ huri a wuri Iyesu. Na a̱ hendi wu, a hyen wo a ga'i be'awo byawa.
Na a Yesu wo pece ohato, wa̱ ka̱ci tu hura̱n ceso nonwan.

A̱bire a owangya Iyesu yan'on woto wu ruma̱ngi ma'inna wu wa̱ta̱ki n uturu. na Yesu hendi tomasana anmen twawa, wa hyen wo, “ba'a wu mi ga'a to na'an netama en dan anmen cende, a wo ciringa̱gi ciri'i towo.
Ta'a yan'on shima̱la̱n she tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa, sha hyen n shenmen shawa, woto wonna, wu ma̱ngashi,
Ayesu ka naande wo yan'son etama nanwan, wa hyen ga yegu naande ayen netama na kenoko n shenmen shihin?
Nce ena huri orara goma: ato hyan, ‘Awo ciringa̱gi ciri'i towo,’ ko ta'a awo hyan ‘Kurka̱ ku regi tohano towo’
Ama nen saro ke yan'son nhyen Ba'a wo woto wo omange a̱ta̱ra̱n nata ciringa̱gi ciri'i to kanniyan, ta'a wa hyen woto wure wu ruma̱ngi, “Ikurka̱, ku wa̱rigi etaro nanwon ku huri giye.
Owa ka wa kurki wa̱ huri giye.
Na ukutu u hendi a̱nde, ryansan rya kentane ga, a hewake Onhon, awo pa̱ni ato a̱ta̱ra̱n.
Na Ayesu ga̱'i pa̱re, wa̱ hendi yan'on woto awo rira̱'i rewa Amatiyu wo koreke, owa a Matiyu ka woto wo tora'aga ka̱gondo go. A Yesu wa hyen wo, “N dopya, wa̱ kurki ta'a wa rope wo.
She Ayesu won korya iri korya n egewa na Matiyu ato na tora'aga ka̱gondo nato naande ciri'i a rage a korkake pa̱ka̱ nonwan nato na moma'anga nonwan.
Na a Farisiyawa a̱ hendi a̱nde, a̱ rushigi ato na moma'anga na Yesu a hyen, “Yegu naande woto ototo wuhin wan korya iri korya n woto wo tora'aga ka̱gondo pa̱ka̱ ta'a nato naande ciri'i
Na Yesu hoge a̱nno wa hyen ga, e rawo na ta̱ganu ato na ruma̱ngi ciwu n woto wu unibu, sede ato na ruma̱ngi.
Ryaga ba ki ma̱ma̱'a̱ngi ena ma ange, ga̱mi ka ane'en na yanman go nen saro pihin, ba iwuki ba. Naande n dage cewo ohece na ato na omange kaye, ama pa ato naande ciri'i go n dage.
A̱bire ato na moma'anga na Yohana wo baptisma a rage pi Yesu a̱ rushigi wu a hyen, “Yegu naande ga̱tu na Farisiyawa aton re'ore, ama ato na moma'anga nanwon a ca na'an rewa?”
Ayesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “Atoginto na u'a̱ngo a rawon ton da anmen shiri she u'a̱ngo u ta̱n pa̱ka̱ nanwan? Ai beka̱ni be ne'en na an tu umena̱ ga u'a̱ngo a̱bire be an ton da re'ore.
“Woto wo rawo awon tu ta̱ga̱nu ewa na goshe n yade na̱son a̱ ta̱gi, enande a na̱son an ta handa ana goshe, hare tu a̱ni to hando tu ka̱hin.

Woto wo rawo ta'a awon tu kuga̱ ma̱ni ma ina̱bi ma̱son n shemo she goshe, she a̱ kuga̱ni, shemo shen to komatongo, ma̱ni ma ina̱bi ta'a ma turi, sede a̱ kuga̱ni n shemo she son. She an de a̱nno ma̱ni ina̱bi ma rawon tu tura̱ ko ta'a shemo she komantango.”

She Ayesu wo tan monran ma̱re nanwan go a̱nde yan'on woto ototo wa rage pi Yesu wa̱ cibi arungurungu wa hyen wo, benanba nanba ba'a wumi wa̱'a̱ wu u. Ama rage tun huri ku a̱ta̱n bo n ka'ara kawo won ta ronkya.
Ayesu ta'a wa̱ kurki wa rope wo pa̱ka̱ n ato na moma'anga nonwan.
A̱bire ta'a yan'on wu'a̱ awo den nyan opa na rewu n tu hure ma̱hen'en wa peringe na bo'o na Yesu wa̱ a̱ta̱ni ewa nonwan.
Nande wu'a̱ wure wa hyen nanmen nonwan, ko she ewa nonwan e bawa go n a̱ta̱ni, nen mohoga.”
A̱bire Ayesu wa mangiyane wa hendi wu'a̱ wure wa hyen wo, “ba'a wumi ga'a mata etama, tomasana anmen towo to hogake” A̱bire ta'a be wa mohoge.
Na Ayesu wuci egewa na woto ototo wure wa̱ hendi ato na rinhunrin pa̱ka̱ n kutu pa̱re a hwadane kwara.
Wa hyen ga“N pa̱gi ba pa̱ri ai ba'a wota wu u ciwu ndawon go me wa̱ wa̱ci” a henge Yesu.
Na a sortoma ukutu niji, a Yesu wa̱ gegi wa kentane ka'ara ka ba'a wure a̱bire ba'a ka ronkya.
Monran ma̱re ka ma̱ ci kobe be'awo be cenge ture.
Na Ayesu wo maheketane pa̱re ta'a yan'on a̱ruwa̱ rewu, a rope wo n tu'umena̱ bengoro a ange, “Gawo Ba'a wo Dauda hoga yanman na̱tu.
Na Ayesu gegi ne yan'on egewa, a̱ruwa̱ wa̱re a rage pi Yesu wa hyen ga, e masane anmen nhyen n omange a̱ta̱ra̱n na nen be hogaka?” A̱ ra̱'a̱ni Yesu a hyen, “En Ashawa”
A̱bire a Yesu wa̱ a̱ta̱nga̱ni shishe shawa wa hyen ga, “Mande mahenda n to masana anmen tuhin.”
A̱bire shishe shawa she ma̱'ucigi. Ama Ayesu wa woshe ga ogago mahenda nhyen“Nde n hoge cewo mago pa woto wuba̱.”
Na a̱ huri ka a̱ hita̱gi mago kobe be'awo be cenge ture.
Ayesu a̱ kurki gu a̱nde an tu hura̱ a owangya wo yan'on wuka̱mu awo omange npera nan gamangan bo tu hita̱ga̱ ndoma.
Na a sortoman gya wo npera, wuka̱mu wure wa̱ hita̱gi ndoma, a̱bire ukutu owa de mamake, a hyan, “Tu ta̱ hen cewu anna n Israila.”
Ta'a ato ototo na Farisiyawa a hyan, “Na ta̱ra̱n nan men pera go wan to sortomanga npera”

a Yesu wa peringina̱ n ceson ceson n shihira̱ wa ne'en tu bisa̱ga̱ n pa̱ri pa aduwa nanwan, wan to bansan monran ma rotome ma togoma to Onhon, wan ta'a to hogaka ka ga kobe shegoma n rara kamon nanwan.
Na a Yesu wu hendi uru na ukutu wa hoge yanman nanwan n ma̱supo mawa, woto wo rawo ta'a wu beni ga a ne'en she ita̱ma̱'in na rawo wuhuwa̱.
A̱bire a Yesu wa hyen ato na moma'anga non wan, “Uguwa̱ u yemi, ta'a ato nan ton da Uguwa̱ a̱ yen ciwu.
Rushiga̱ ba Ashawa na Uguwa̱, aye tomangya nato na Uguwa̱ nahwa.”
Ayesu wa hecegane ato na moma'anga nonwan opa na̱ rewu, wa̱ pa̱ni ga a̱ta̱ra̱n na to sortomanga ko'ebe nperan nan shiri, ta'a a hogake kobe shegoma n rara hoga rato.
Ta'a a̱ra̱'i na atoma wa̱re moma'anga opa na rewu, woto wo ka̱hin saminu awo ata hecega Bitrus n wotosuwa̱ wo wa Andarawus, na Yakubu ba'a wo zabadi wotosuwa̱ wo Yohana.
Na Filibus na Batalomi na Toma na Amatiyu woto wo tora'aga Ka̱gondo na Yakubu ba'a wo Halpa, na Tadiyos na Yahuda,
Na Saminu Baka'ane na Yahuda Iskariyoti awun ka̱ci Iyesu
Ato opa na ato rewu wa̱re go Ayesu wo tomane wa̱ pa̱ni ga uno wa hyen“Kire ki gegi ciwu n cenge to ato nande cewo Ayahudawa, ko ta'a ko'ebe oceso na Samariyawa.
Sede ki huri pa ato na Israila ana nangi.
Ke na'an tohano ke na'an bansan ke anga togoma to tonran to ne'enyan keto.’
Ki kurtuma̱ ato na o'gi ke ce'enyanke ato nkoci ke sortoma npera, nde i bicigi a̱nde en to pana
Ki ga̱'i tu ume nsara ko ezenare ko azurpa ko otagulla na̱bi na̱hin
Ki ga'i tu ume okwasha na tohano, ko ewa na̱hin rewu ko ataka ko a̱ngo, woto won toma wu ha̱'in a̱ pa̱ni wu ocewa nonwan
“Ko'ebe oceso ko a̱hira̱ ta'a na i gegi ki sa̱ri woto wo omange kaye ke na'an negewa nonwan hare ki ga̱'i pa̱re.
She i gegi n egewa ke hyen ga ha̱nu ba dai.
She a̱ ra̱'a̱ni nkuna̱n nan hin okamo na̱hin o nan'an pa̱re, she a̱ ra̱'a̱ni ciwu, okamo na̱hin o mokosha pihin.
Ca egewa na eshe tohoga monran ma̱hin, she en to sora n oceso ki birka̱ki kurutu ko shewona shihin
Mahenda mago man ne'en bi bisa̱ga̱ n hibi na shetara an ta hura̱ to hoga be'awo be cenge to Saduma n ta to Gomora n ceso wa̱re.
Ewana n be tomane she ita̱ma̱'in nacenace na a̱kurwo. Naande a̱nno ke etange nshe ahwa'a, ta'a ke na'an nshe ato naca hacega nshe ka̱rkutu.
Ke owane suku na ato, nande an be owana n pa̱ri pa shetara, aye owane ta'a n pa̱ri pa maromano mawa wa̱ta̱gi nwo'o
Sa̱bo na̱mi ta'a an be owana nekogo na ato ototo nan goma, na en ma bisa̱ ga monran ma rotome nekogo nanwan pa ato nande cewo Ayahudawa.
She aye kentane ki ga̱'i etama na monran ma in tu hita̱, beka̱ni bi ce an bi bisa̱ monran ma in tu hita̱.
Enande nce ga̱hin gu monran ama benhyan be onhon Ashawa bihin gu won monran nanmen ga̱hin.
Wotosuwa̱ won to pana wotosuwa̱ wowa a kone wo, ashawa ta'a an to pana ba'a, a'o ta'a an ma̱kurka̱nu nato na ma̱ci ga hare a̱ kuwa̱ni a kone ga.
Ko'eyawa ta'an be esa sa̱bo na rira̱'i rimi, ama woto pa̱ri anmen hare wa eyake, an tu ringe wu.
Sha ayi pinrin n ceso na ki ga̱ri tu hura̱n ceso na̱ba̱. Mahenda mago ma nen bisa̱ga̱, kahen ki hu tu peringa̱na̱ nceson ceso nan me Israila, Ba'a wo Woto won mokosha.
woto wo moma'anga wo rawo awo huri ka̱ma̱la̱n kawa, ko ta'a wogema a̱ huri ashawa na egewa nonwan.
Ma rogo woto wo moma'anga a na'an nshe ka̱ma̱la̱n kawa, wogema ta'a, a na'an nshe ashawa na egewa nonwan. She a hecegane ashawa na egewa Ba'alzabul to yegu ta'a an to hyan na ato na egewa wa̱re.
Naandea̱nno ki ga̱'i to hoga ryansan ryawa, naande e rawo na uta̱ni ena a rawon tu uciga̱ ego, ta'a e rawo na ma̱so'in ena a rawon to yan'son.
Enan bi bishi rihinrihin ki hici mago marara, ena ayi bishi natobe ta'a ki ba̱nshi mago n bikira̱n be egewa.
Ki re ke hoge cewo ryansan re ato nan to yan'son to kona woto, ama a rawon to yan'son to kona behono. Ma huri ke hoge ryansan re woto won to yan'son to kona to'oawa pa̱ka̱ n behono n egewa na ora.
Nce a tan ka̱ta̱ n'na̱na̱n dewu ukobo uka̱, to ke rawo aken to kena n kida̱ ke Ashawa a rawon to yan'son.
Ai ko tunjira̱ tu unbu na̱hin ma a ronce togo.
Naandea̱nno ki ga̱'i to hoga ryansan, ai huri nna̱na̱n ma̱nde.
“Ca woto wu ra̱'a̱ni nhyan owa a̱wu mi go nan to ra'a ta'a nhyan owa a̱wumi go nekogo na Ashawa na̱mi awon tonran.
Woto wo hyan ta'a won yan'cewo nekogo na ato, ga̱mi ta'a nan to hyan n yan'cewo nekogo na Ashawa na̱mi a nan tonran.
“Ga'a ba to anga nhyen n dage n owane okamo n kanniyan go. N owan cewo okamo n kanniyan, ama renbota rego ren owane.
N dage go n kwantan “‘woto na shawa nonwan rebonta, ba, a wa̱'a̱ na nanwan, wu'a̱ wo ba, a ta'a na ananwan na wa̱ri.
Ato nan nanmen negewa na woto go an to na'an rishiwu nonwan.’

Ca woto wu huri tu ruwa̱ ashawa ko ananwan nonwan n ga̱mi, wu ha̱n'in ciwu an den woto wo moma'anga wumi, ta'a woto wu huri tu ruwa̱ ba'a wowa wa̱ri ko ba'a wowa wa̱'a̱, wu ha̱n'in ciwu an den woto wo moma'anga wumi.
Ca ta'a woto wu umi ciwu kawo'o ka ton gyanran ka̱mi wan rope ba, wu ha̱n'in ciwu an den woto wo moma'anga wumi.
Woto wu rubin tu ringe behono bewa, won to rasa bego, ca ta'a woto wu ra̱shi behono bewa sa̱bo na̱mi, wun tu biciga̱ bego.
“Ca woto wuyi ra̱'i, wun ra̱'i gu a̱nde, ca ta'a woto wun ra̱'i, wu ra̱'i woto won tomane.
Ca woto wu ra̱'i Wotoma wo Onhon naande owa Wotoma go, wun tu ciga̱ ocewa na Wotoma, ca ta'a woto wu ra̱'i woto wo kaye naande owa woto wo kaye go, won to ra'a ocewa na woto wo kaye.
Ta'a she woto wuba̱ wu pa̱ni ko she keronkwa kika̱ ki ma̱ni ma horpi n woto wanna wo nennen enaande won de woto wo moma'anga wu mi gu, n bi bishi mahenda Onhon on topana wo ocewa nonwan.”
Na Ayesu wu hu ton dangya ato na moma'anga nonwan opa na rewu ogago wa̱ ga̱'i pa̱re wa̱ huri wan tu bisa̱ga̱ n to bansan nan ceson ceson nanmen n Galili.
Na A yohana hoge ena Kristi won nenwan she won kurkuku, wa tomane ato na moma'anga nonwan
A̱ rushige wo nhyen, “Gawo go woto wo ne'enyan dewo a̱ka̱ tu shi'a̱ a̱she n woto wuba̱?”
Ayesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “Ryaga ba ki bishi yohana ena e hoge aye hendi ta'a:
A̱ruwa̱ a̱ hendi pa̱ri, ato na ma'inna ta'a an tohano, ato na omange nkoci ta'a a mohoge, a̱ka̱mu a hoge monran an tu kurtuma̱ ato na o'gi, a na'ange na ota̱gi to bansan to monran ma rotome.
Uno na reme on pa woto wo waca marocega sa̱bo na̱mi.”
Na ato na moma'anga na Yohana a̱ huri, Ayesu wa̱ rigi ukutu monran ma Yohana wo Baptisma wa hyen, “Yegu e sore to hyande n cenge tu ho'i? E sore to hyande anben na gensangage ana operan tu wuka̱ gwa?
She nce a̱nno gu, yegu e sore to hyande? En netama nhyan en to hyanda woto wo mata'ane aronga na reme gwa? Ai ato nan na ne'en n kapara ka wogoma go ta mata'ana menwan nan remange.
To yegu e sore to hyande? Wotoma wo Onhon? En, n bi bishi, wu huri Wotoma wo Onhon.
A̱ure wo an range monran muwa ama hyan: “‘Nen to tomane Wotoma wumi a̱ wu ciga̱ni, awon bo nangana onyan she wota rage cewo.’
Mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱ga̱ nanmen nato ca ana a̱'a̱ a̱ ma̱ta̱ngi woto wo rawo awo sorya awo huri Iyohana wo baptisma uru, ama ca a̱nde, woto wu huri to na'an ryawo n togoma to tonran wu huri wu.

Nasorya nan n'yan nan Yohana wo baptisma hare ta rage benna togoma to tonran ton dewan to swa tupira̱n n tu kurtuma̱ shenmen, ato na tu kurtuma̱ shenmen ta'a an saron to kapshega togoma ture to Onhon nan shita̱.
Enande tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa na takada na atoma na Onhon a̱ hito monran ma togoma ture she an Yohana wo baptisma wota rage cewo.
She ta'a en to ra'a to tomane tawa, Ayohana go won de a Iliya awo an de monran ma orewo nonwan.
Woto wo omange atobe na to hoga a hoge.
To niwo gu an to ma'ana nyan manna? Nshe a'o go ana koreke apa tunka̱ci n to sanga, an hece na ayan'on nanwan na togaro go a ange,
“‘Tuyi hunra̱ngi rihunrin, ai hebe cewo cehewa, a ton pa̱ku na u'o a̱yi ta̱ ciwu ngwa.’
Ewana A yohana wo rage wa eshe korya e ryage ryage ni sogi sogi a hyan, ‘Wo omange npera.’

Na Ba'a wo Woto wo rage wan korya wan toswa, aye hyan, ‘Hyanda ba woto wonna wu pici korya n to swa, wotoginto wo woto wo tora'aga ka̱gondo nato na “Ciri'i”’ Ca a̱nde an to mapanga toyanson to Onhon n toma nonwan.”
Nande Ayesu wa̱ ri tu gusa̱ nceson ceson na men wan de otoma na tohyanda na wan den nanmen, enaande ka ato wa̱re a eshe a ma̱shishingi.

“Yana na̱hin, Korasin! yana na̱hin, Betsaida! Sha ana hyan otoma na tohyanda na an de pihin gu ana den n Taya pa̱ka̱ n Sidon, she ana ma̱shishingi hare a̱ mohopa̱ga̱ni mato a̱ ma̱pa̱ra̱gi shesoma n to'oawa tawa.
Ama ni bisa̱ga̱ n hibi na shetara an tu hura̱ to hoga ato na Sidon na Taya n ga̱hin.

Gawo ta'a Kaparnahun on netama na to hyan an bo hewaka tu hura̱ n tonran gwa? A'a, an bu wa̱ta̱ka̱ gu ato no esa go hare tu hura̱ apa ane'en na ato na o'gi. Otoma na tohyanda na an dange nanmen gawo sha ana hyan iwa̱re ana de n Sodom she o nan dewa hare yara.
Ama ni bisa̱ga̱ n hibi na shetara an tu hura̱ to hoga yanman na ato be'awo bya Sodom n ga̱hin.”
Na uhibi wa̱re gu Ayesu wo hyen “N bu kuni Ashawa, Ashawa naande tonran n kanniyan, enaande wu son'in iriri wanna pa ato na yan'son pa̱ka̱ nato na moma̱'a̱ngi, a̱ wu bishi a'o nan nennen.
En, Ashawa, naande ena wu hura̱ni ore wa̱re.
Ashawa na̱mi a̱ pa̱ni ca iriri. Woto wo rawo awo yan'son Ba'a wure ba̱nta̱ na Ashawa, ta'a n woto Ba'a wu ta̱ri a̱ bishi wu.
“Rage ba pimi ca na̱hin ato nan ma̱supo ato na utumi n re'owana re aronga na monren, nen be pana ohorna.

Pana shi'unbu shihin n monran ma̱mi nshe nde bena'an beta pana bengoro be bewa pa utubi na toma, ki ma̱ma̱'a̱ngi ta'a pimi, enande ga̱mi woto wo yanman go, woto wu ra̱uga̱gi unbu ta'a, ta'a in tu ciga̱ ohorna n shenmen shihin.
Enande cegema tumi nca to gome togo, aronga na̱mi ta'a a manren cewo.”
N beka̱ni bire n hibi na a̱subi she Ayesu won to anyan shehwa she oalkama ato na moma'anga nonwan a hoge remonron a̱bire a̱ ri to harpaga resore re oalkama an korya
Na Aparisiyawa a̱ hendi a̱nno a hyen Iyesu, “Ruka̱ ato na moma'anga nanwon an ena reme cewo n hibi na a̱subi.”
Ayesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “E ta rotange cewo ena A dauda won den na wa hoge renmonron gwa, uwa natoginto na tohano tuwa.
Na wa̱ gegi n egewa na Onhon, pa̱ka̱ na yan'on na tohano tuwa a re iri korya na a̱ shi'a̱gi Apristoci ena reme cewo awa a re.
A̱ka̱ ta'a eta roncen cewo ena tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa to hyen n uhibi na a̱subi gwa, Apristoci nanmen ka̱'uma̱na̱ ata anyan odoka na a̱subi, ba n yan'on mangasa ba?
N ne'en bi bisa̱ga̱, awo huri egewa na Onhon won pana.
She ena yan'son ma'ana ma ewanna to hyan, ‘Ga̱mi ane'en na yanman go nen saro pihin nce iwuki go,’ ena rawon to hyanda mangasa ma ato na rawo mangasa.
Nade ba'a wo woto a̱ure Ashawa na A̱subi
Na Ayesu wa maheketane pare wa̱ gegin ka̱woro ka aduwa.

Ta'a yan'on woto won dewa pa̱re awo ma'inna n ka'ara Aparisiyawa a̱ rushigi Iyesu a hyen, “Man man dan n tubisa̱ga̱ tu Mosa a hogake n uhibi na a̱subi? na an ma̱ ciga̱ ena an to awana kara kau wa go.”
Ayesu wa hyen ga, “She woto wuba̱ n nanmen ga̱hin wo omange bita̱ma̱'in bya kenan n hyanbe n uhibi na a̱subi wo rawon to gega̱ a sortome bego?
Maa̱n ba na woto wu huri bita̱main odaraja! Nadea̱nno ma reme ato an de ena reme n uhibi na a̱subi?”
“Nande Ayesu wa hyen woto wure, n cewane ka'ara kawo.” A̱nde wa cewane ka'ara kau wa ta'a ka mahoge, ka mokoshe she kayan'on.
Ama A Farisiyawa a̱ huri niji a pare na an to kentana Iyesu a kone wo.
Na Yesu ma̱pi a̱nno, wa maheketane wa̱ ga̱'i pa̱re, ta'a ato na yemi a rope wo wa hogake ga ca.
wa washe ga ogago a ga̱'i tuhita̱ uwa awa go.
Ama̱no na an ma shintuma̱ monran ma Wotoma wo Onhon a Ishaya wo hyen.
Wogema wu mi wanna, awo n rubi, awo n nanmen cende nonwan, mahenda nan to masangya wo benhyan be onhon, won tu bisa̱ ato na yan'cewo Onhon onyan na mahenda
Wo rawon to bonta ko ngwa, woto wo rawo awon to hoga bengoro be wa nonyan.
Be'onto bi ma̱nguci wo rawon to kosaga bego, becella be no'an tu uwa̱ga̱ wo rawon to kona bego, onyan na mahenda mamande.
N rira̱'i re wa go ca toroma kanniyan ton ta mansa anmen nonwan.
Nade ato na̱ba̱ a owangya wo yan'on wuruwa̱ wuka̱mu awo nperan wa hogake wo wuka̱mu wa hita̱gi, wa̱ hendi pa̱ri.
Ato ca an de omamake a hyen “A̱ka̱ ba'a wo Dauda wonna?”
Ama na Aparisiyawa a hoge a̱nno, a hyen, “Na̱ ta̱ra̱n na ba'alzabul, wogoma wo npera, go woto wonna won to sortomanga npera.”
Enande Ayesu wo yan'son etama nanwan, naande wa hyen ga ca togoma to ma̱ra̱wanu, ton to hacega, Oceso ta'a n egewa na ma̱ra̱wa̱nu e rawon to esa.
She kitunbul keta sortoma kitunbul, ke warano unbu na kewa go a̱nde. Nago togoma tu kewa ton to iyaka?
She na̱ta̱ra̱n na ba'alzabul go nta sortoma npera, na̱ ta̱ra̱n nanwan go ato na̱hin ata sortoma? Nadea̱nno na a̱nno, a̱wa̱re an be dangya shetara.
Ga̱mi ta'a she na̱ta̱ra̱ na benhyan be Onhon go nta sortoma npera, togoma to Onhon toye ragane wa̱no.
“Ko ta'a, nago woto wuba̱ won tu gega̱ negewa na woto wo omange a̱ta̱ra̱n’ a̱ shiga̱ni aronga nonwan, nca she sha wu cigi to kara woto wure wo omange a̱ta̱ra̱n? naande a gegi n egewa nonwan.
“Owa woto wo rawon pa̱ka̱ n ga̱mi, won rishiwu n ga̱mi, ta'a woto wo roman cewo n ga̱mi wota wasergaka.
A̱nde ta'a n bi bishi, mahenda a ciringa̱gi ca ato ciri'i tawa n mangasa mawa, ama woto wo ma̱ga̱shi n benhyan be Onhon a rawon to recengagya wo

Ko'ewa awo de monran ma reme cewo n ba'a wo Woto an tu ciringa̱ge wu, ama awo de monran ma reme cewo n benhyan be ce'en a rawon to ciringa̱ge wo, ko n kanniyan ko nan n'yan manna ko ona ne'enyan nonyan.
“She e remake o'o ri'ori re owa ren to rema, a̱nde ta'a she e remake cewo o'o ri'ori re owa ta'a re rawon to rema, ata mapa o'o n ri'ori re owa go.
Ga̱hin a korowa, nago ga̱hin re de ato na kenoko en to yan'son tu hita̱ ena reme? enaande ena shemen shihin ri rubi go eta hita̱.
Woto wo reme wota sortome monran ma reme n rekoko re wa, ta'a woto wo kenoko wota sortome ena kenoko n rekoko re kenoko wata sortomange iriri.
Ama n bi bishi mahenda n uhibi na shetara ato an to hita̱ ca ena an de.
N monran mawo mago man bo sortoma, ko ta'a ma wu ka̱ri.
Nande yan'on shima̱la̱n she tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa na Aparisiyawa sha hyen wo, “Ka̱ma̱la̱n, ton saro to hyanda yan'on osheda na sorya pewo.”
Ayesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, ato an nyan manna ana kenoko anan ma̱ye'o go an saro to hyanda yan'on osheda! ama yan'on osheda o rawo na an tu bisa̱ ga ba̱nta̱ n osheda na Wotoma Yunusa.
Sha nde Ayunusa won den a̱hibi atato na geta tato nanmen biwo bi uru, a̱nde ba'a wo woto won ton da ahibi atato na geta tato n cenge
N hibi na shetara ato na Neneba an to esaga nato na nyan manna a̱ kiri ga na an magetoge n to bansan to Yunusa, ta'a awo huri Iyunusa won panna.

N hibi na shetara Sarauniya na be'awo be kinda̱n won tu kurika̱ pa̱ka̱ nato na nyan manna a kiri ga, nande wo rage naswarya tuhuwa̱ to kanniyan a hoge to yan'son to Sulemanu, ta'a woto wu huri Isulemanu won pana.
“She nperan nan kenoko n sorya pa woto.
A̱bire n ta hyen nen mokosa negewa na̱mi enan sorya a̱bire na wan mokosha, a wuri egewa ka woto wo rawo nanmen, i washigi e ma kyarange.

A̱bire wa huri wa tarya nperan nan mibo nan shigere, ntuda̱re, nnan huri wu kenoko, n rage n gegi pa̱re a me koreka. Wato anene'en nonwan a̱n tu hura̱ ana ka̱hin to hacega, a̱nno man to na'an n kenoko ke nahon.
Won monran wa̱nu nato ananwan na yan'on sha asage ninji an saro ton dan monran na Yesu.
Yan'on woto wan hyen wo kamaca kawo na yan'on nanwon esage pare nindi an saro ton dan monran gawo.
Ayesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni woto wure wo hyen wo, “A̱ure won den kamaca ka̱mi na yan'on na̱mi?
Nande Ayesu wa cewane ka'ara pa ato ma ma'anga nonwan wa hyen wo kamaca ka̱mi na yan'on na̱mi wana.
Ai ko awa awon den ena Ashawa na ne'en nanmen tonran an saro a̱ure won den woto suwa̱ wumi a̱ure ta'a kamaca ka̱mi.
N hibi wa̱re ta'a Ayesu wa sore n egewa wa̱re, wa̱ huri wa koreke n be'awo be ube.
Ato na yemi cenmon a rage pewa, hare iye ci pa Yesu wu pece ohato wa kwarke, ca ato wa̱re a eshe n suna̱
Nade wa̱ bisa̱gi ga iriri na yemi na akosa, wa hyen ga: “Yan'on wohwanyan go wu re kobera.
Na won to tara eyan'son eyan'on eya kenange nonyan, nna̱na̱ meya rage me ta̱ngi.
Enyan'on ta'a eya kenange napaga apa rawo cengen abe eye pushe eye cigi ciwu cenge tu iri cenmon
Na onhun o naande iye waini enaande i cigi ciwu ini'i cenmon iye ho'i
Eyan'on ta'a eya kenange na sa̱pi, na a̱sa̱pi a̱ kurke a sonkan ego.
eyan'on ta'a iya kenange n cenge to reme iye pa̱ni esargo, ina̱ba̱ tariya, ina̱ba̱ opa ta̱nihin, ina̱ba̱ opa tato.
Nade aYesu wa kokane to hyan woto wo omange atobe, a hoge.”
Nade ato na moma'anga a a rage pi Yesu a̱ rushigi wu a hyen, “Nago wota na'angya ato monran nakosa go?
A Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “Ga̱hin aye ga̱'i ke yan'son tuso'a̱n to togoma to tonran, ama awa a ga̱'i ciwu ga.
Enaande, woto awo omange iri go ata kasana wo hare i yemi, ama woto wo rawo ka ko ryawo re wa omange ata ra'a
Iwa̱re naande an na'ange ga monran na kosa: “Enaande ko she a̱ ruka̱ni a ca hyanda, ko she a̱ shi'i atobe a ca hoga, a ca ta'a mapa.
An de a̱nno go na an ma̱ shintuma̱ monran ma Wotoma wo Onhon a Ishaya ama hyan: “En to hoga ama e rawon to mapa, en to hyanda ama e rawon to mapa.

Enaande shenmen she ato wanna she otope, a̱ ura̱ni shetobe shawa, a̱ uta̱ni ta'a shishe shawa na a rawon to hyanda na̱she nanwan, a hoge na tobe nanwan ta'a na a rawon to hoga n shenmen shawa a magetoge n hogaka ga.
“Ama uno na reme un na̱she na̱hin enaande ata hyanda, n shetobe shihin she tohoga.
Mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱ga̱, atoma, nato na reme na yemi a̱ rubin to hyanda ena i hendi a̱ hen ciwu, a̱ rubin to hoga ena e hoge a hoge cewo.
Nanba hoga ba ena akosa na wohwanyan a hyen.
Woto hoge monran ma togoma wa̱ ma̱pi ciwu mago, woto wo kenoko wota rage ki ka̱pshigi ena a bere n shenmen she ato, a̱ure won de enyanson na kene nonyan.
Enyanson na kene na paga na rawo cenge cenmon ta'a ato na hoge monran ma Onhon go a̱ ra̱'i na anmen cende.
Ama naande a rawo ini'in na gegi n cenge eya ca eyaka, she yan'on ma̱supo ma ragan bo kan na monran ma onhon ma̱re a mokoshe na bo'o.
Enyason na kenen na sa̱pi a̱wa̱re ato na hoge monran ma̱re ama rishe n toma'on to kanniyan n bicigo ota kakarga monran ma̱re, hare ma̱re ma rakau otoma.
Enyanson na kenen n cenge to reme a̱wa̱re na hoge monran a̱ ma̱pi mago, mahenda a̱wa̱re a ton da esargo, hare an den, na̱ba̱ tariya, na̱ba̱ opa ta̱nihin, na̱ba̱ opa tato.”
Ta'a Ayesu wa owangya ga yan'on akosa wa hyen: “An to man'anna togoma to tonran she woto awo ri enyanson nahwa nonwan.
Ama she ato an nan dawo, woto wo rishiwu wo wa rage wa̱ ri eyan'son na anbe nanmen nahwa na alkama wa̱ huri iri nonwan.
Na oalkama wa̱re u kurki a̱ ori, anbe a sorya.
“Wogema wo woto wo egewa wa rage pewa wa hyen wo, woto wo egewa nca enyanson na reme na alkama go wu shin nahwa nanwon?, Nca pa anbe a sorya?
“‘Woto wo egewa wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga, yan'on woto wo rishiwu go won den iri wanna, wogema wa̱ rushigi wu a hyen won saro tun huri tun kuba̱gi to romano gwa?’
“‘wa hyen ga, ga'a ba ma̱re pa tukunba̱ga̱ anbe ki kubi ca na alkama.
Ga'a ba anbe a na'an pa̱ka̱ she ohwa'a u ci, a̱bire nan tu bisa̱ ato na ohwa'a a cigi to hwa'a anbe wa̱re a romano a̱ pa̱pa̱rgi arowa arowa a dortoma, oalkama ka a romano a rogane n kapanga ka̱mi.”
aYesu wa̱ bisa̱ka̱ni yan'on akosa wa hyen, “Togoma to tonran ton she byan'son be omostad go, ena yan'on woto huri wa bere nahwa nonwan.”
Ko na eyan de a̱bire ben de enyanson na huri to na'an ryawo nyanson, ama she bi yemi bi huri ca ana ceni awowa en de e'o hare nna̱na̱ n dage men den tugurgu n shira̱'i she owa.
Ayesu ta'a wa̱ bisa̱ka̱ni ga yan'on akosa wa hyen, “Togoma to tonran she uyist go twa ne'en, ona yan'on wu'a̱ wu umi wa̱ biron ta̱hi to oalkama toma'a to tato hare to kurki.
A Yesu wa̱ bisa̱gi ato na yemi ca iriri nakosa. waca bisa̱ ga yen'unrin she wo masane cewo akosa
An de ma̱re na an ma shintuma̱ tu hita̱ to Wotoma wo Onhon a Ishaya go ama hyen, nan ton da monran nakosa nan tu bisa̱ga enan ma̱soin n ma̱riye ma kanniyan.”
A Yesu wa̱ ga̱'i ukutu ma̱re wa̱ gegi negewa, ato na moma'anga nonwan a rage pewa a hyen wo, “Tu uciga̱gi akosa wanna na anbe na ahwa mana.”
A Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “Woto wo ta̱ ra̱ enyanson wa̱re reme a̱ure Ba'a wo Woto.
Ahwa ta'a kanniyan kago, enyanson wa̱re ka a'o na togoma to Onhon go anbe ka a̱wa̱re a'o na woto wo kenoko go.
Woto wu ri enyanson na anbe wa̱re ka a̱ure kitunbul beka̱ni be ohwa'a ka tuhuwa̱ to kanniyan togo, ato na ohwa'a ka atoma na a̱ba̱ye na Onhon go
“She nde a̱ kunbin anbe a romano abe a dortoma ago, a̱nde en to na'an n tuhuwa̱ to kanniyan.
Ba'a wo woto won to tomane na atoma na a̱ba̱ye nonwan, an to romano ca ato na ton da a'eyawa a ma̱ga̱shi, ca nato na kenoko a sortoma ga n togoma towa.
A masane ga nanmen nora na ba̱'i, a̱pa̱re pa an to na'an nan ngwa n marya a̱ne.
Nade ato na reme an to ha'anka she onhun n togoma to Ashawa, woto omange atobe na to hoga a hoge.
“Togoma to tonran she ubicigo gu twa ne'en ona bisa̱ni nahwa, ona woto wuba̱ wu cigi wa̱ bisa̱ka̱ni, wan nanmen cende nonwan, naande wa̱ huri wa̱ ka̱ta̱ngi ba̱nba̱n ena wa omange wa̱ ahwa wa̱re.
“Hare benanba togoma to tonran she woto wo omange ena ka'ara go twa ne'en, wan saro ulu'uluu ona omange odaraja.
Na wa̱ cigi ulu'uluu uka̱ na reme cenmon, naande wa̱ huri wa̱n ka̱ci ba̱nba̱n ena wa omange wa shan ogo.
“Ta'a togoma to tonran she ka̱tuuwa̱ go twa ne'en ona a masane nube, uwa kentaganen kobe iri nan nwa̱
Na uwa̱ shini a̱ hundika̱ni ogo n kogo a koreke a̱ ta̱ngi nwa̱ nan remange, a̱ kunin go nagora, nnan reme cewo a ka a̱ turin go.
A̱nde man to na'an n tuhuwa̱ to kanniyan, atoma na a̱ba̱ye na Onhon an to sorya a̱ sa̱bi ato na kenoko nanmen nato na reme.
A mashen ga nanmen nora nan tu hunda̱na̱, a̱pa̱re pa an to na'an nan ngwa n marya a̱ne.
“A Yesu wa̱ rushigi ga wa hyen, i ma̱pi ba̱nba̱n ewanna?” a hyen “En,”
A Yesu wa hyen ga, “Ca ka̱ma̱la̱n ka tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa ka made woto moma'anga n togoma to tonran, she ashawa na egewa go wa ne'en, awo tare ubicigo na̱son nona goshe n kapanga kawa.”
Na Yesu hu tu hita̱ akosa wa̱re wa̱ kurki pa̱re.
Na wa ragen n ceso nanwan, wa̱ bisa̱gi ga n ka̱'uma̱na̱ kawa, hare an de mamake a hyen, “Nca pa woto wonna wu cige toyanson anna, ta'a n muujizai anna?”
“Nce ba'a wo wushebi wure go wanna, ananwan nonwan nce rira̱'i rewa a maryamu gwa, ayan'on nonwan ta'a nce a Yakubu na Isuhu na Saminu na Yahuza gwa?
Ayan'on nonwan a̱'a̱ nce pa̱ka̱ pa̱gu to na'ange nanwan han, nca pa woto wonna wu cige toyanson anna ba̱nba̱n?”
Nade a marocege sa̱bo nonwan, Ama a Yesu wa hyen ga, “Wotoma waca rasa ototo sai n ceso nonwan negewa nonwan.”
Ta'a a Yesu wan de cewo umuujizai na yemi pa̱re, enaande a̱ pa̱n ciwu shenmen n Nazarat.
N beka̱ni be a Hiridus wogoma wo Galili wo hoge monran ma tosora to rira̱'i re Yesu,
Wa hyen agema nonwan, “Awonna a Yohana wo baptisima go, wu kurke nu'o iwore naande wa omange a̱ta̱nra̱n na ton danga iriri na na̱son anna.”
Enaande pa̱re a Hiridus wo kentano i Yohana wa̱ ka̱ri wu n kurkuku sa̱bo na a Hirudiya, wotosuwa̱ wo wa wu'a̱ wo Filibus,
a Yohana wona hyan wogoma a Hiridus: “E reme cewo wo na'anga nonwan.”
Kon eyande a Hiridus wogoma wona ruwa̱ to kona i Yohana, wa hoge ryansan re ato na Israila enaande a rwane wo Wotoma go.
Na uhibi na rima̱ci re wogoma a Hiridus magetogya a Hirudiya ba'a wo wa wa̱'a̱ wa hebe cenmon
hare wa̱ shi'a̱gi nonwan nan ma̱shiwuro wa hyen won to pana wo ena wa̱ rushigi.
Ama na ananwan a̱ hurpa̱n bo atobe a hyen ashawa, n pa̱ni unbu na Yohana wo baptisima n katogwa kanna.”
Wogoma a Hiridus wan de usuwa̱ shiri, ama enaande wu ma̱shiwuro na wako nonwan, wa̱ kuwa̱ni a̱ pa̱ni wo ena wa̱ rushigi
Wogoma a Hiridus wa tomane a epya unbu na Yohana n kurkuku.
A owane unbu na Yohana n katogwa a̱ pa̱ni ba'a wo wa wa̱'a̱, wa uwange ananwan.
Ato na moma'anga na Yohana a rage a̱ umi to'uwawa to Yohana a̱ ma̱n. Nade a̱ huri a̱ bishi i Yesu.
Na a Yesu hoge a̱nno, wa pece ohato rihinrihin wa̱ huri pa rawo ko woto. nto hogana a̱nno, ato nasorya nan ceson ceson a rope wo n shewona.
Na wa soren hato wa̱ hendi ato cenmon, wa hoge yanman nanwan wa hogake shegoma shawa.

Na marauna ma ne'enyan keto, ato na moma'anga a rage pewa a hyen wo, “Pa̱ri panna pa rawo ko woto, ewana ta'a onhun o no'an tu ira̱. Cepana ato a̱ huri, na an ma gega̱n shihira̱ a sange iri na korya.”
Ama a Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “Nca shesha a̱ huri. Ga̱hin pana ga ba yen'unrin a re mana.”
Ato na moma'anga nonwan a̱ ra̱'a̱ni a hyen, ‘Kapoka ka tan nan nwa̱ n dewu gya go to omange.
Wa hyen ga, “N owangya ba pana,”

Nade wa̱ kuwa̱ni ato a korekaka na anbe. Wa̱ umi kapoka ka̱re ka tan nan nwa̱ dewu wa̱ umena̱n tonran wa̱ rogane Onhon. Wa kergano kapoka wa̱ pa̱ga̱ni ato na moma'anga nonwan awa ta'a a̱ ta̱ra̱ta̱gu ato.
Ca nanwan a re ko'eyawa a̱ ciga̱gi, ato na moma'anga a̱ shiga̱ni ucencemu hare shakope she opa n sheshi rewu ena a̱ ga̱'i.
Ato na re ka a̱ ci tariya opa anta na̱ a̱ na̱ ri na o.
A̱birebire a Yesu wa̱ kuwa̱ni ato na moma'anga a̱ gegin ohato a̱ ciga̱n bu to kaca ube, na wa cepane ato.
Na wa cepane ga, wa̱ na̱da̱ni ka̱'undu obawa an de aduwa. Na marauna man de, wa̱n pa̱re obawa,
she ohato uta̱ ci ciwu, arasana na ma̱ni an turipa̱nga̱ ogo opera ta'a owan tu wuka̱ ogo.
N tu'uma̱ to tato to ogeta a Yesu wan topodanga tu hura̱ pyawa n ma̱ni rowa.
Na ato na moma'anga a̱ hyande won tohano n ma̱ni rowa, a hoge ryansan. A hyen “Bewa bego,” a̱ ta̱ to'ogwa maryansan ryansan.
A̱birebire a Yesu wa hyen ga: “Ga'a ba etama para ba shenmen ga̱mi go. Ga'a ba to hoga ryansan.”
A Bitrus wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni wa hyen, “Ashawa, she gawo go n mahenda,” “Hyen n dage pewo n ma̱ni rowa.”
A Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱n bo wa hyen wo, “Rage,” A Bitrus wa sore n ohato, wa̱ regi n ma̱ni wa rage keto na Yesu.
Ama na wa̱ hendi opera wa hoge ryansan wa̱ ri tu ira̱, wa̱ ta̱ be'ogwa wa ange, “Ashawa, n ringe”
A̱birebire a Yesu wa cewane ka'ara wa kentan bo wa hyen wo. “Gawo woto wo tomasana anmen tu yemi ciwu, yegu e won de oshakka”
Na a̱ gegin ohato, opera uwa̱ ga̱'i tu wuka̱.
Ato anan nanmen ohato a dange i Yesu sojada, a ange, “Mahenda gawo Ba'a wo Onhon go.”
Na a Yesu nato na moma'anga nonwan a̱ ka̱ci a̱ ka̱ra̱ni Janisarat.
Na ato na pa̱ pa̱re a ma̱pi i Yesu, a tomangan ca cenge ton be'awo bire. Ato a uwangane ato na ruma̱ga̱gi pewa
a̱ rushigi i Yesu a̱ a̱ta̱ni ko she ewa nonwan go, ca woto awo a̱ta̱ni ewa nonwan wa mohoge.
Naande yan'on a Farisiyawa n shima̱la̱n she tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa a rage pi Yesu nasoryan Urshalima a̱ rushigi wu a hyen,
“Yegu den ato na moma'anga nanwon a ta'a kosa oal'ada na ato ototo? a ca ma̱hita̱gu sha'ara naande a re iri korya!”
a Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga, wa hyen ga̱hin ta'a nago eta kosa monran ma Onhon sa̱bo na iwuki na̱hin
Enaande Onhon wa hyen ku pa̱ni ashawa nanwon na ananwan nanwon ototo’ ta'a ‘Ko'eyawa awo to'age ashawa ko ananwan an to kona wo.
Ama aye ta bisa̱ga̱ nhyen she woto Omange iri na wan tu bena̱ ashawa nonwan ko ananwan nonwan nenwan ama wa hyan, ‘Ca, ena ina̱n tu biciga̱ pimi n shi'a̱gi Onhon.
Wato sa̱bo na al'ada na̱hin aye gotage monran ma Onhon nce yen'unrin go aye rubi ciwu to pana ashawa na̱hin ototo.
Ga̱hin ato na tuka̱ryo! Dede go na Wotoma wo Onhon a Ishaya won de uanabci n unbu na̱hin na wa hyen
“‘Ato wanna nuno bawa go an man paga ototo. ama rekoko ryawa re magesangano n ga̱mi.
Wusu go an na'ange n sojada, tubisa̱ga̱ tawa to ato go ama a ange to Onhon togo.”’
Nade a Yesu wa hecegane ukutu na ato wa hyen ga, “Shi'a̱ ba atobe ki ma̱pi.
N ce iri na ta̱ gega̱ n nuno na woto go ton da a ‘shigere’ Ama ena ta sorya nuno na woto go e ton da woto a ‘shigere.”’
Nande ato na moma'anga a rage pi Yesu a hyen, “Wo yan'son nhyen anmen na aParisiyawa a̱ ha̱ciga̱ni anmen n monran ma wu hici?”
A Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “Ca kobera ko den cewo ko Ashawa na̱mi anan tonran bere cewo an tu kunba̱ga̱ kogo.
Garega ga ba awa a̱ruwa̱ go ana ta owangana a̱ruwa̱ onyan. She ka wuruwa̱ wo owangane wuruwa̱ onyan, ca nanwan an makoceka n ka̱nga̱rmu.”
Ama a Bitrus wa hyen i Yesu“Tu uciga̱gi akosa wanna mana.”
aYesu wa̱ rushigi ga wa hyen, “Hare benanba eta ma̱pi ciwu gwa?”
“Nan monran ma tohyan ena woto re n ma̱riye e ta gega̱ nuno nonwan go naande i huri n suwa̱ naande e sore n to'oawa towa?
Ama iri na ta sorya nuno n rekoko, go eya ta sorya iwore ka ta dan woto a shigere nekogo na Onhon.’
Naande n rekoko go etama na kenoko, eta sorya kamashe tokona woto n ma̱'a̱ pa̱ka̱n ma̱ye'o, n rihin n shaida na tobya n tohacegana rira̱'i.
Iriri na ton da woto a ‘shigere’ wono ama korya n ka'ara ka mahita̱gu ciwu kaca ca da woto a ‘shigere.”’
A Yesu wa̱ ga̱'i pa̱re gu a̱nde wa̱ hanrane be'awo be cenge to Taya n Sidon.
Yan'on wu'a̱ wo Kan'ana wa rage pi Yesu wa̱ kurtuma̱ bengoro wa hyen wo, “Ashawa, Ba'a wo Dauda hoga yanman na̱mi! Yan'on nperan nan shiri n dipi ba'a wumi wa̱'a̱.”
Ama a Yesu wa̱ guringi ciwu. Nade ato na moma'anga nonwan a rage a̱ sa̱ri i Yesu a hyen wo, “Ita̱ wu mana, enaande wo ne'en mato ropana wa̱ tu shintuma̱ atobe in to'ogwa.”
Ama a Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga, wa hyen, “Ga̱mi pa ato na na̱gi na Israila go an tomane.”
Ama wu'a̱ wure wa rage wa̱ cibi a̱rungurungu nekogo na Yesu wa hyen, “Ashawa n beni.”
A Yesu wa̱ ra'an bu wa hyen, “Ma rawon to rema a̱ umi iri korya na a'o a̱ pa̱ni sha.”
“Nade wu'a̱ wure ta'a wa hyen, “En, Ashawa ama ko sha she ta rya iri korya na kenange n tabur na ato na egewa.”
Nade a Yesu wa ra̱'a̱n bu wa hyen, “Wu'a̱, wo omange to masana anmen to otope! Ena wu rubi e man de”A̱birebire ba'a wowa wa̱'a̱ wa mohoge.
A Yesu wa̱ ga̱'i pa̱re ta'a wa rope be'awo be ube na Galili. Naande wa̱ na̱da̱ni ki'undu wa koreke pa̱re
Ukutu ato na yemi uwa rage pewa, a owangane ato na raga shewona na na̱ ruwa̱ na ka̱mu na ato ta'a cenmon a̱ shi'a̱gi ga nekogo na Yesu wa hogake ga.

Hare ato an de omamake na a̱ hendi a̱ka̱mu an monran, ato na omange a̱dungu ta'a a n'on nan mewa mya ne'en toma, ato na ragawo shewona ta'a an tohano, a̱ruwa̱ ta'a a̱ hendi pa̱ri, a̱bire a hewake Onhon na Israila.

A Yesu wa hecagane ato na moma'anga nonwan wa hyen ga, “Nan nen yanman na ato wanna naande yara ageta nanwan a tato she a̱n pa̱ka̱ n ga̱mi, a rawo ta'a ena an korya. A̱n rubi ciwu n capana ga n remonron, Ma̱re a'eyawa a na'an jinga̱na̱ nonyan na huri giye.”
Naande ato na moma'anga na Yesu a hyen wo, “Nca pa ton tu bicige kapoka ka ton koryaka ato wanna n pa̱ri panna pa rawo ko yen'unrin?”
A Yesu wa̱ rushigi ga wa hyen, “Kapoka ka hanba kago ka e omange, a hyen wo“Kapoka ka tunda̱re kago ka to omange gya nan wa̱ ryawo.”
Naande a Yesu wa hyen ukutu na ato o koreka n kida̱.
Naande wa a Yesu wa̱ umi kapoka ka̱re ka̱ tunda̱re nan wa̱ kuwa̱ni Onhon, wa kosagano wa̱ pa̱ga̱ni ato na moma'anga awa ta'a a̱ ta̱ra̱ta̱gu ato.
Ko'eyawa wa re hare wa̱ cigi. Na a̱ hu ato na moma'anga na Yesu a romano ucencemu hare shakope shi tunda̱re.
Ato na re ka a̱ri a̱ ci n'mo'on na̱shi, ba̱nta̱ na̱ a̱ na a'o
Na Yesu wo cepane ukutu na ato, wa̱ pece ohato wa hanrane cenge to Magadan.
Aparisiyawa na Sadukiyawa a rage pi Yesu a̱ ma̱'in wu, a̱ rushigi wu a hyen a bishi ga alama nasorya n tonran.
Ayesu wa̱ ra̱'ani ga wa hyen, “She marona man de aye hendi tonran to magetoge tu shende eta hyan ehen pa̱ri pan to rema bi'i, ama e rawon to yan'son to bisa̱ ato alama na beka̱ni.
Ta'a n bongwa sha i hendi alama na pa̱ri pa ici eta hyan, ‘Yara a̱shira̱ an to kena, enande tonran tu wusu to magetoge tu shende.
Ato na nyan manna ato na kenoko go ato na korya amana anan saro a̱ hendi yan'on alama ama a rawon yan'on alama na an to bisa̱ ga ba̱nta̱ nalama na Yunana.” Nade a Yesu wa̱ ga̱'i ga wa huri.
Na ato na moma'anga na Yesu a̱ ka̱ci hira̱ re nube, a̱ ma̱ga̱'isa̱ni tu ume kapoka.
A Yesu wa hyen ato na moma'anga nonwan, “Shi'a̱ ba a̱she,”“Ke bereka n yist na Farisiyawa na Sadukiyawa.”
Ato na moma'anga na Yesu a̱ ri mahyango, “A̱ka̱ nde to rage cewo n kapoka go?”
Na Yesu wu ma̱pi an de naande wa̱ rushigi ga wa hyen, “Ga̱hin ato na to masana anmen na yemi ciwu, yegu de aye ange e rawo kapoka?
Hare benanba eta ma̱pi ciwu gwa? I ma̱ta̱ma̱ringi ciwu nan ryake ato n'mo'on mentan n kapoka ka tan, shakope she hanba shego she e romano?
Ko ta'a nan ryake ato n'mo'on na̱shi n kapoka ka̱ tunda̱re shakope she hanba shego she e romano?
Nago i ma̱pi ciwu nhyen nca monran ma kapoka mago man be na'ange mawa? Nhyen ke bereka unbu na̱hin n yist na Farisiyawa na Sadukiyawa.”
Nade ato na moma'anga na Yesu a̱ ma̱pi nhyen nce wo ange a bereka uyist na ata kuna̱ n kapoka go, ama n tubisa̱ga̱ to Sadukiyawa na Farisiyawa go wa ange.
Na a Yesu wo rage n be'awo ba cenge to Kaisariya n Filibi a Yesu wa̱ rushigi ato na moma'anga wa hyen, “A̱ure ato a ange nhyen Ba'a wo Woto wo ne'en?”
A hyen i Yesu, “A'eyawa a ange a Yohana wo baptisma go, a'eyawa a ange a Iliya go, a'eyawa ta'a a ange a Irmiya go, ko ta'a woto wuka̱ nanmen na Wotoma.”
Ama a Yesu wa hyen ga “Ga̱hin ta'a a̱ure en ange?”
Nade a Simon Bitrus wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni wa hyen, “Gawo go a Kristi, Ba'a wo Onhon awo na'anan.”
Nade a Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni i Simon Bitrus wa hyen, “Gawo woto wo uno na reme go, Simon ba'a wo Yona, naande n ce woto shiri go wu bishi, ama na sorya pa Ashawa na̱mi anan pa̱re n tonran.
Ne wo bisa̱ga̱ go gawo a Bitrus, n tare wanna rowa go nan to ma ato na toropa na̱mi, ana u'o o rawo a̱ta̱ra̱n nanwan.
Nen bo pana ena tu uciga̱ togoma to tonran, ko'iwo na ika̱ ri n kanniyan en to na'an i ka̱ri n tonran, ena i ka̱rigi ta'a n kanniyan en to na'an i ka̱rigi n tonran.”
Naande a Yesu wa̱ hundika̱ni ato na moma'naga nonwan a̱re bishi ciwu ko'eyawa nhyen a̱ure a Kristi.

Na̱ri bire a Yesu wa̱ ri tu bisa̱ atona moma'anga nonwan nhyen ma kentane a̱ hurin Urshalima a hengago ba̱nta̱ ba̱nta̱ n sha'ara she ato ototo na Firistoci n shima̱la̱n she tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa, kone wo ta'a ama n hibi na hen tato a̱ kurtuma̱ wo.”
Naande a Bitrus wa̱ hundika̱ni i Yesu n be'awo wa̱ gusa̱ni bo wa hyen wo, “Onhon rawon to ga'a ma na'an a̱nno Ashawa!” “A̱ma̱no ma rawon bu ciga̱!”
Ama a Yesu wa̱ mangiyane wa hyen i Bitrus, “Ma̱ra̱wa̱nu n ga̱mi, gawo Kitunbul! Gawo woto won ma̱n kuwa̱ marocega go, won netama na woto go ama nce etama na Onhon go.”
Naande a Yesu wa hyen ato na moma'anga nonwan, “Ca woto won saro nan dopa, she sha wo eshe unbu nonwan a̱ umi kawo'o ka tongera kawa an dope.
Ca woto won saro behono bewa won ta rasa bego, ama ca woto wu ra̱shi behono bewa won tu biciga̱ bego.
Yegu woto wun ta̱ ciga̱ she wu bicigi kanniyan, wa̱ ra̱shi behono biwa? ko ta'a yegu woto to pana ena huri behono biwa?
Naande Ba'a wo Woto won to rage na atoma na a̱ba̱ye na Onhon nonwan na̱ta̱ra̱n na Ashawa, a̱bire be wan to to pana ko'eyawa ocewa na otoma nonwan.
Mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱ga̱, a'eyawa an panna a esage ana rawon tu uwa̱ga̱ hare she sha a̱ hendi to rage to Ba'a wo Woto n togoma towa.”
Na ageta ta̱nihin a̱ huri naande a Yesu wa̱ umi i Bitrus na Yakubu, pa̱ka̱n wotosuwa̱ wo wa a Yohana wa owane ga n yan'on undu rowa ona gesange abawa.
Naande maperano mawa ma̱ ma̱shishingi, a̱bire a̱she nonwan a magetoge ba̱ka̱ she tohan'an to onhun, aronga nonwan ta'a a magetoge ba̱ka̱ an to han'anga.
Naande ato na moma'anga wa̱re a tato a̱ hendi atoma a Mosa na Iliya a rage an monran na Yesu.
Nade a Bitrus wa hyen i Yesu, “Ashawa, ma reme na ton panna. She wu ra̱'ani, n ciba̱ shipa̱ku she tato, uka̱ o nanwon, uka̱ ona Mosa, uka̱ ona Iliya.”

She a Bitrus wo tan monran, a̱ hendi yan'on kanran ka̱ she'in ka̱ uta̱ni ga, a hoge ta'a yan'on bengoro nasorya n kanran ka̱re be ange, “Ba'a wumi go wota, awon rubi ta'a awon ne'en nanmen cende nonwan ki shi'a̱n bu atobe”
Na ato na moma'anga a hoge a̱nno, a kenen kida̱, ryansan rya kentane ga.
Nade a Yesu wa rage wa̱ ta̱ta̱ga̱ni ga, wa hyen “Ikurka̱ ba” “Ga'a ba to hoga ryansan.”
Na a̱ umena̱n shi'unbu, a̱ hen ciwu ko'eyawa ba̱nta̱ na Yesu obawa.
Sha a ne'enyan guriga̱nu nudu a Yesu wa woshe ga ogago wa hyen, “Kire ki bishi ciwu ko woto ena i hendi, she sha a kurtuma̱ Ba'a wo woto nu'o.”
Ato na moma'anga na Yesu a̱ rushigi a hyen, “Yegu en de shima̱la̱n she tubisa̱ga̱ to Mosa a ange nhyen ma kentane a Iliya cigi to rage?”
A Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “A̱nno ma kentane a Iliya a̱ cigi to rage, a nanganane ko'iwo.
Ama mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱ga̱, a Iliya wo ragwa a̱ ma̱pi ciwu hare an dange wo ena a̱ rubi. A̱nde ta'a Ba'a wo Woto won to hengago n sha'ara shawa.”
A̱bire be ato na moma'anga na Yesu a̱ ma̱pi nhyan monran ma Yohana wo baptisma mago ma Yesu wo na'ange ga n mawa.
Na a Yesu nato na moma'anga re a tato a̱ ci apa ato a manronmano yan'on woto wa rage pewa wa̱ cibi a̱rungurungu nekogo Yesu.
Wa hyen wo, “Ashawa, hoga yanman na ba'a wumi,” “Awon shegoma she o'eyanbe won ma̱supo cenmon. Bekene wota kena nora, n ma̱ni ta'a.
N owane wo pa ato na moma'anga nanwon ama a yan'cewo to hogaka wo.”

Nade a Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni wa hyen, “A ga̱hin ato na tomasana anmen tu yemi ciwu” ato na otopa unbu na nahon, “Hare wahon go nen to na'an pa̱ka̱ n ga̱hin? hare wahon go ta'a nen to para anmen n ga̱hin? N owangya wo ba pana.”
Nade a Yesu wa̱ gusa̱ni, npera ma̱nde ta'a mya ma̱ra̱wa̱nu nonwan, a̱bire ba'a wo wa mohoge.
Nade ato na moma'anga a rage pi Yesu rinhinrinhin a̱ rushigi a hyen, “Yegu naande ato yan'cewo to sortoma nperan ma̱nde?”

A a Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “Enaande to masana anmen tuhin tu yemi ciwu gu. Mahenda mago nan bi bisa̱ga̱ she ena omange to masana anmen tu ci byan'son bi bi'eni, en to yan'son to hyan undu na, ‘Ikurka̱ pana ko mokoshe pa̱re, ka̱ kurki ta'a. E rawo ta'a nan be garga.”
Iri wanna ca sora sai pa̱ka̱ naduwa n re'ore.
Na ato moma'anga na Yesu a manronmano pa̱ka̱ n Galili, a Yesu wa hyen ga, “An to cewa Ba'a wo Woto n sha'ara she ato.
An ka to kona wo, ama n hibi na hen tato an tu kurtuma̱ wu.” Nade ca ato moma'anga nonwan a̱ri shenmen shi shiri.
Na a Yesu nato na moma'anga nonwan a rage n Kaparnahun, ato na to ra'aga ka̱gondo ka egewa na Onhon a rage pi Bitrus a̱ rushigi wu a hyen, “Ka̱ma̱la̱n ka̱hin kata topa ka̱gondo?”

Wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “En, wota topa.” Na Bitrus wu gegi negewa a Yesu wa̱ ri to dangya wo monran wa hyen wo, “Yegu wu hendi a Simon?” “Pyawa pago pa ngoman nan kanniyan ata ra'aga nsaran nan rehatana nan ka̱gondo, pa a'o nanwan a̱ka̱ pa ato na̱ba̱?”
A Bitrus wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni wa hyen, “Pa ato na̱ba̱,” Naande a Yesu wa hyen i Bitrus, “Eya de a'o nanwan a ca topa wono.”

“Ama ma̱re to hacega ga shenmen, re manca nube, ko masan manca biwa̱ bi wu cigi to kentane ka a̱bire be won to ume. She wu ucigi uno na bewa wun tu wura̱ oshekel uka̱ nanmen, ku ume oshekel wa̱re ko owangya ga, on to rogo to topa ka̱gondo ka̱mi n gawo.”
N beka̱ni bire ato na moma'anga a rage pi Yesu a̱ rushigi wu a hyen, “A̱ure wu huri uru n togoma to tonran?”
Naande a Yesu wa hecegane yan'on ba'a wo nennen, wa̱ shi'i wu nacenace nanwan.
Wa hyen ga: “Mahenda mago man nan bi bisa̱ga̱, she i ma̱ shishingi ciwu, aye ne'en she a'o nan nennen e rawon tu gega̱ n togoma to tonran.
Woto awo kentane unbu nonwan she ba'a wo nennen, owa woto uru go n togoma to tonran.
“Ta'a woto wu ra̱'i ba'a wo nennen she wonna n rira̱'i rimi wun da̱'i.
Ama woto won de wuka̱ na'o nan nennen wan de ciri'i, in tu hura̱ wu a̱ ka̱ri wu onamon na uru n bengoro bewa a irtuma̱ wu ta'a nanmen nube na uru na iri.
“Yana kanniyan enaande eta dan ciri'i! ma kentane ena tu kuna̱ ciri'i e rage, yana na woto wu kuwa̱ni ton da ciri'i ture.

She ka'ara kawo ko ta'a kawona kawo kata wu kuwa̱ ton da ciri'i, to kera kago ku ta̱'i. in bu hura̱ ku gegi n behono be rawo be'epo n ka'ara ka̱ka̱ ko kawona ka̱ka̱, na an bo masana nanmen n ora na ca uwa̱ga̱ n sha'ara shi rewu ko n shewona shi rewu.
She ta'a rishe rewo re tawo kuwa̱ ton da ciri'i, koika rego ko mashe. In bu hura̱ ku gegin behono be rawo be'epo n rishe rika̱ na'an bo masana nora naca uwa̱ga̱ na̱she nanwon rewu.
“En da ba suku ma̱re i gina̱ ko wuka̱ na'o nan nennen. Nan bi bisa̱ga̱, atoma na a̱ba̱ye nanwan tonran bekene ata hyanda a̱she na Ashawa na̱mi a nan tonran.
Ba'a wo Woto wo rage go a sortome ena na̱gi.
“Yegu en netama? she woto omange ita̱ma̱'in tariya, bika̱ be na̱gi, wo rawon to ga'a e opa cishi na̱ cishi a̱re saro na bika̱ bi na̱gi?
Ta'a she wo hyande bego, n bi bisa̱ mahenda, won tu hura̱ ton da anmen cenden be bire bika̱ nena ceni.
A̱nde ta'a Ashawa na̱hin anan tonran wu rubi ciwu woto wo ciri'i a̱ na̱gi.
“She woyan'on wo wo dange ena ren cewo, hura̱ ku bishi wu ena wa wo de, ga̱hin rewu nonwan. She wo rangatane, wo koshetomakan bo go a̱nde.
Ama she wo ragatan cewo a hoge monran ma wo, ku hura̱ kan pewa n woto wuka̱ ko ato rewu na an to mapa kobe monran ama ri na shedu a tato.
She wo eshe to hoga mawa, ku bishi ato ototo na ato na toropa, she wo eshe to hoga ga, ko rwane wo she woto wo yan'cewo Onhon ko ta'a woto wo tora'aga ka̱gondo awo rawo kaye.
“Mahenda mago ma nan bi bisa̱ga̱, ena i unpin n kanniyan, en to na'an i upo n tonran, ena i ka̱rigi ta'a n kanniyan a̱ ka̱rigo n tonran.
“Ta'a, n bi bishi pa ato rewu n kanniyan a̱ ra̱'a̱ni koiwo na i rushigi yen'unrin, Ashawa na̱mi anan tonran won be dangya ego.
Apa ato rewu ko atato a ne'en n rira̱'i rimi nan pa̱ka̱ nanwan.”
Nade a Bitrus wa rage pi Yesu wa̱ rushigi wu wa hyen, “Ashawa, mahanba mago ma woto won bo dangya iri ku ga̱'i wu ma tunda̱re?”
aYesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱n bu wa hyen wo, “n bu bishi, nce ma tunda̱re ma bawa, ama hare ma opa tunda̱re n ma tunda̱re.
“Nadea̱nno, togoma to tonran to ne'en she wogoma won saro agema nonwan a̱ bishi wu na nsaran nan mewa n ne'en.
Na wogoma wure wu ri tonrontan, a owangya wo yan'on woto wo omangan bo atalent na yemi.
Na wa rawon to yan'son to topa, woto ototo wa hyen wo a̱ umi wu n wu'a̱ wowa na'o nonwan nena wa omange a̱n ka̱ci a tope wo otace wa̱re.
“Wogema wa̱ cibi a̱rungurungu nonwan n kida̱. wa̱ sa̱ri an dange wo ha̱kuri, won to topa koiwo’.
Ashawa na egewa na wogema wure wa hoge yanman nonwan, wa̱ ga̱'a̱gi wu otace wa̱re wa̱ ga̱'i wu a̱ huri.
“Ama na wogema wure wo sore niji, wa̱ buri woyan'on wo wa wogema awo omagan bo odinari tariya. wa kentan bo bengoro wa hyen wo, ‘N tope ca otace na̱mi na won omangane.
woyan'on wure wo wa wogema wa̱ cibi a̱rungurungun nonwan n kida̱ wa hyen wo, ‘N men dange ha̱kuri, nan bo topa.’
“Ama wa eshe. Hare wa owane wo a̱ ka̱ri wu wan hyen she sha wo tope wo nsaran nan mewa.
Na agema na̱ba̱ a̱ hendi na a̱nde, an de usuwa̱ shiri a̱ huri a̱ bishe woto ototo wa wa koiwo n monran ma̱re.
Naande woto ototo wa wa wa hecegane wogema wure nanmen. Wa hyen wo, ‘Gawo wogema wo kenoko, n bu ga̱'a̱gi otace nanwon naande wun roki.
Ma ha̱'in ciwu ta'a gawo ko hoge yanman na woyan'on wo wogema shen den hoge yanman nanwon?
A̱bire wogoma wan de usuwa̱ shiri woto wa̱ kuwa̱ni a̱ ka̱ri wu a ce'entoma wo hare she sha wo tope otace wa̱re.
“Nade a Yesu wa kokane to hyan anna Ashawa na̱mi anan tonran an to dangya ko'eyawa awo eshe to ga'agya woyan'on wo wa na anmen a̱ka̱.”
Na Yesu wu hu monran ma̱re, naande wa̱ ga̱'i cenge to Galili wa gegi n Yahudiya, onan hira̱ re n ube na Urdun.
Ato cenmon a rope wo, naande wa hogake ato na ruma̱ga̱gi pa̱re.
Naande yan'on a Farisiyawa a rage pewa a̱ ma̱'in wu, a hyen wo, “Ma reme woto a̱ ta̱cigi wu'a̱ wo wa n kobe monran?”
a Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “E rontonge cewo monran ma Onhon gwa,” “Nhyen n ma̱riye Onhon won de ga wa̱ri n wu'a̱,’
Ta'a a Yesu wa hyen ga, n ma̱ma̱no wa̱ri won to ga'a ashawa nonwan na ananwan nonwan a na'an pa̱ka̱ n wu'a̱ wo wa, awa rewu an de to'oawa tuka̱?
A dankan cewo awa rewu ama a̱ka̱. N ma̱ma̱no ena Onhon u ga̱nta̱n woto rawo awo ra̱wanu.”
Naande a̱ rushigi i Yesu a hyen, yegu den a Mosa wa hyen woto a̱ pa̱ni wu'a̱ wo wa otakada na otacegwa a ita̱n bu?
A Yesu wa̱ ra̱'ani ga wa hyen, “Sa̱bo na otopa unbu na̱hin go o de a Mosa wa hyen ki ta̱cigi a̱'a̱ na̱hin, ama nce a̱nde ma ne'en ma̱riye.
a Yesu wa hyen ga n ne'en bi bisa̱ga̱ woto wu ta̱cigi wu'a̱ wo wa, shen ce nhyen wo kentan bo n ma̱ye'o gu, ta'a wa̱ ha̱ni wuba̱ wun maye'o gu nande,”
A̱bire ato na moma'anga na Yesu a hyen wo, “She a̱nno ma ne'en n wu'a̱ n wa̱ri, ma huri woto a̱ ga̱'i ton da riheni wa̱no.”
A Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni ga wa hyen, “Nce ko'eyawa gon to ra'ana tubisa̱ga̱ tonna, sai ato na Onhon u pa̱ni.
Ato an dewa na a̱ ma̱ci ana rawon ton da rihenni, an dewa ta'a na ato go an de ga, ato na̱ba̱ ta'a a̱ rubin rihenni sa̱bo na togoma to tonran. Woto won to yan'son to ra'a a̱ ra̱'i mago.”
A'eyawa a owangane a'o nan nennen pi Yesu a tatan ga ka'ara an dange ga aduwa. Ama ato na moma'anga a woshe ato na owane ga ogago.
Ama a Yesu wa hyen ga, “Ga'a ba a'o nan nennen a rage pimi, enaande ato na ne'en she a'o omange togoma to tonran.”
Na wa tatan ga ka'ara, wa̱ regi tohano towa.
Yan'on woto wa rage pi Yesu wa̱ rushigi wu wa hyen, “Ka̱ma̱la̱n, yegu nan ton da ena reme na nan ma̱ ciga̱ behonno be bekene?”
“A Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni wu wa hyen, yegu en de a̱ wun rushigi ena reme?”“Woto wuka̱ wu go won de awo reme. She won saro tu ciga̱ behono bire, ko rope monran ma shi'i.”

Woto wure wa̱ rushigi i Yesu wa hyen“Monran ma shi'i ma̱be?” ma woto won to ropa. Ama a Yesu wa̱ ra̱'ani bo wa hyen, ga'a to kona woto, ku ga'i ton da maye'o, ku ga'i to na'an rihin, ku ga'i to pana osheda na tobya,
Ko rope ashawa nanwon na ananwan nanwon, ku rubi ato nde wu rubi unbu nanwon.”
“wogama wa hyen, ca monran ma̱no n a̱no mago. Yegu nan ton da ena ta̱n cena̱n?”
A Yesu wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni wu wa hyen, “She won sara tu shina̱, hura̱, kun ka̱ta̱ngi ca ena wo omange ku ta̱ra̱ta̱gu, a̱'uwa̱ta̱gi, won ton da ubicigo n tonran. Naande kon dopya.”
Na wogama wure wo hoge ena Yesu wu bishi wu wa̱ huri n suwa̱ shiri, enaande wo omange toryan'on.
Naande a Yesu wa hyen ato na moma'anga nonwan, “En to goma woto wo omange toryan'on a̱ gegi n togoma to tonran.
Ta'a n bi bishi, en tu hura̱ orara goma ura̱kumi u gegin hyanbe na bejemanran na woto omange toryan'on ma̱ gega̱ n togoma to Onhon.”
Na ato na moma'anga na Yesu a hoge a̱nno, an de mamake cenmon a hyen, she a̱nno ma ne'en, “A̱ure wun tu ciga̱ turinge ture?”
Ama a Yesu wa ginyanne ga wa hyen, “Ena rawon man da go pa ato, ama pa Onhon ko'iwa̱ ena ta man da.”
A Bitrus wa̱ ra̱'a̱ni i Yesu wa hyen, “Ewana tu ga̱'i ko'iwo ato wo rope, Yegu tun ta̱ ciga̱ wono ta'a?”

A Yesu wa hyen ga, “N bi bishi mahenda, she a̱ shishingi ko'iwo, n beka̱ni be Ba'a wo Woto won to koreka n ka̱shiki kau wa ka togoma ka ototo, ga̱hin ato na moma'anga na̱mi nan rope ta'a en to koreka n shishiki she togoma she opa n sheshi rewu shire, ke dange toroma to opa n totu rewu re Israila shetara.
Ta'a woto wu ga̱'i egewa nonwan na yan'on nonwan ko ashawa ko ananwan ko a'o ko shehwa sa̱bo na̱mi won to ra'a so ma tariya a̱ cigi ta'a behono be bekene.
Ama ato cenmon na cigi an to haikana, n togoma to Onhon, ato cenmon na haika̱ni ta'a an ton dan ato na cigi n togoma to Onhon.
“Togoma to tonran ton sha yan'on ashawa na egewa go awo soren bongwa wa owane a hwanyan a hwange wo kaboga.
Na won de tunka̱ci nanwan udinari uka̱ uhibi, wa̱ tucinga̱ni ga n kaboga ka̱re ka wa.
“Na wa de honran wa sore wa̱ hendi ato na̱ba̱ ana rawo yan'on otoma a esage pa tunka̱ci n tosanga.
Wa hyen ga, ‘Ga̱hin ta'a hura̱ ba n kaboga ka̱mi ken de otoma n be topa ena ha̱n'in ta'a.’
A̱ huri ta'a. “Wa̱ hura̱ka̱ni niji abe marauna wa dankane monran ma̱re ma̱ka̱.
Abe marauna ta'a wa sorakane wa̱ wuri ato na̱ba̱ ta'a she a esage a rawon n kobe otoma. Wa̱ rushigi ga wa hyen, ‘Yegu na de aye korkake uhibi koko she e rawon yen'unrin?
“A̱ ra̱'a̱n bo a hyen wo, woto wo rawo awo tu umi otoma.’ “Wa hyen ga, ‘Ga̱hin ta'a hura̱ ba n kaboga ka̱mi ke de otoma.’
“Na marauna man de, woto wo kaboga wa hyen woto wo wa ta tomana, hecegane atoma ko tope ga, ku riye nato re haika̱ni hare tu hure nato na ka̱hin.’
“Ato re a rwane otoma marauna a rage ko'eyawa wa̱ cigi udinari uka̱.
A̱nde na ato re a rwane ka̱hin a rage an netama an to pana ga nan yemi. Ama awa ta'a ko'eyawa a̱ pa̱ni wu udinari uka̱.
Na atoma re cigi a̱ ra̱'i a na'ange ashawa na egewa ihunrinhunrin.
‘A ange, ato na rage otoma nanbananba,’ta'a a tope ga ba̱kika̱ n ga̱tu re den otoma uhibi koko.’
“Ama ra'ani wutu ka̱, wa hyen wo, ‘Wotoginto wumi, ai n bo dangage cewo. Nce tu ma̱renu go nhyen nan bo topa udinari uka̱?
